The target start date is mid\-October 2026\. **How to Apply** Apply at: https://app.heedhire.com/apply/intk\_3a303547\-8685\-4f76\-89c6\-4ac5b288d142 **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lab3 is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Forward Developed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your at You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process — just ask.* Iw9E8gJI5Z

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an engineer who can turn new modeling and agent ideas into working systems. You will build evaluations, data and inference workflows, backend services, internal tools, and product\-facing experiments while working directly with the founders and researchers. Your job is to shorten the path from hypothesis to reliable software and bring failures observed in real products and real data back into the next experiment. As the technology develops, you will help turn model outputs into useful forecasting, scenario\-exploration, and decision\-support capabilities. This is not a narrow ML infrastructure role, a pure research role, or a management job. You will own reusable technical capabilities, partnering with the data engineer on shared data foundations and the product engineer on the applications that expose those capabilities to users. **What you'll own** * Turn research and agent ideas into working prototypes, evaluations, internal tools, and customer\-ready capabilities. * Build reusable systems for forecasting, covariate search, model\-input preparation, inference, evaluation, and decision support. * Work across model code, APIs, data contracts, workflows, backend services, and lightweight product experiments. * Investigate failures in models, agents, and their surrounding systems, and turn findings into better evaluations and more dependable behavior. * Improve developer experience, observability, reliability, security, and deployment speed where they unlock more research and product progress. * Work with the CTO, Chief Scientist, and CEO on technical direction and the capabilities needed for customer deployments. * Help set the engineering standards for the team, including testing, technical documentation, and sound decisions about what to build or reuse. **What we're looking for** * A track record of taking ambiguous technical problems from an initial idea through implementation and reliable production use. * Strong software engineering skills across backend services, APIs, data workflows, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on experience taking ML models or agent\-based systems into production, including evaluation, integration, failure analysis, and ongoing operation. * The ability to work in research and model code while also building maintainable services and developer tooling. * Technical judgment about when to experiment, when to invest in reusable infrastructure, and when a simpler solution is sufficient. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate directly with researchers, product engineers, and founders. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the modeling stack, data infrastructure, and how our technology is used in Ask The Grid; identify one high\-impact system to own. * 60 days: Ship a working capability that converts research, data, or customer learning into repeatable software. * 90 days: Own a durable technical capability and materially reduce repeated founder engineering work through reliable systems, tooling, or workflows. **Why join** You will help determine how the company's research becomes usable technology. The work spans experiments and production systems, with direct access to the people developing the models and the people using the resulting products. Your technical decisions will shape the engineering team we build around them. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 3 days per week in person. Salary range: $225,000–$280,000 USD.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Software Engineer – Data \& Analytics** **Clinical Automation \& Platform Development** Company: Cole Neural Institute, Inc. Location: Coral Gables, Florida Work Arrangement: Full\-time; hybrid, with regular on\-site availability Reports To: Clinical Director/Founder and Executive Leadership Position Type: Permanent **About Cole Neural Institute** Cole Neural Institute (CNI) consolidates decades of proprietary neuroscience research in mental health treatment into the Cole Neurologic Method — a data\-informed approach combining EEG\-based neuroassessments, neurofeedback, cognitive coaching, psychometric assessments, and physiological data to help clients improve emotional and neurologic regulation. CNI is currently completing the automation of its clinical assessment, scoring, reporting, treatment\-planning, and outcomes\-tracking systems. Our long\-range objective is a complete "Clinic in a Box": a secure, scalable, plug\-and\-play technology and operating platform that will let qualified practitioners and clinics worldwide implement and deliver the Cole Neurologic Method consistently. We're seeking a permanent software engineer who can help us finish what we're building today and become a key technical leader in what it grows into tomorrow. **Position Summary** The Full\-Stack Software Engineer will take technical ownership of CNI's clinical automation systems and help transform the current system into a reliable, scalable, commercially deployable platform. Initial priority: understand, complete, test, document, and support the existing automation — including systems that collect and process psychometric surveys, EEG data, physiological information, client records, proprietary scoring algorithms, clinical summaries, treatment recommendations, and longitudinal outcomes. Longer\-term responsibility: help architect and build CNI's "Clinic in a Box" platform, including practitioner\-facing tools, clinical workflows, automated scoring engines, client management, reporting, integrations, data security, remote support, system monitoring, and multi\-clinic deployment. This is not a short\-term development assignment. Automation systems require continuous maintenance, refinement, quality control, and support. We're looking for someone who wants lasting ownership of a meaningful platform and wants to grow with the organization. **Primary Responsibilities** **Immediate Priorities** * Review and understand the existing codebase, automation workflows, technical documentation, databases, spreadsheets, integrations, and reporting systems * Complete and stabilize the automation currently under development * Translate CNI's proprietary clinical rules, formulas, thresholds, scoring models, and decision pathways into accurate, auditable software logic * Automate the ingestion, validation, scoring, and reporting of psychometric, EEG, physiological, wearable, and clinical data * Build safeguards to identify missing, inconsistent, incorrectly formatted, or clinically improbable data * Develop jobs.title: ML Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an ML Data Platform Engineer to make the data behind our models, products, and customer deployments dependable, understandable, and easy to use. This role sits where data engineering meets machine learning. You will turn messy, changing real\-world sources into durable datasets and interfaces that researchers and engineers can trust. Your work will support both public data and customer\-authorized operational data. The goal is not to build a large platform for its own sake. It is to make each new model, product capability, and data source faster to bring online without compromising correctness. You will own the shared data foundations, working with the applied\-AI engineer on model requirements and the product engineer on application needs. **What you'll own** * Build and improve ingestion, backfills, validation, and observability for high\-volume, time\-dependent data. * Define clear data contracts and point\-in\-time semantics for model training, evaluation, and product use. * Create reusable workflows for bringing public and customer\-authorized sources into the system. * Build quality, lineage, freshness, and access controls that make data trustworthy in repeated use. * Develop efficient datasets and query interfaces for machine\-learning and product workloads. * Diagnose whether failures originate in source data, transformations, model inputs, or serving systems. * Work with researchers and engineers to turn recurring data requirements into reliable software rather than manual projects. * Decide which abstractions should become shared infrastructure and which should remain purpose\-built. **What we're looking for** * A record of designing, building, and operating production data systems that researchers or engineers depend on. * Strong programming, querying, and data\-modeling skills, with the ability to write maintainable, tested production software. * An understanding of time\-dependent data correctness, including backfills, revisions, freshness, and point\-in\-time availability. * Experience supporting ML training and evaluation, or similarly demanding data\-intensive product workloads. * The ability to design practical data contracts, validation, observability, and access controls without overbuilding the platform. * Strong debugging and collaboration skills, including the ability to trace failures across systems and explain data limitations clearly. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the data lifecycle behind Ask The Grid and our ML work, and identify the most consequential reliability and usability gaps. * 60 days: Ship a reusable ingestion, backfill, validation, or dataset capability used in active product or research work. * 90 days: Own a dependable end\-to\-end data workflow, with documented contracts, quality checks, and clear operational visibility. **Why join** The quality of our models and products depends on the quality of their underlying data. You will shape that foundation early, working directly with researchers and engineers who use it, and see your work support new experiments, product capabilities, and customer deployments. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 3 days per week in person. Salary range: $175,000–$245,000 USD.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description: SageOx is a well\-funded, early\-stage startup at the frontier of how AI is shaping the world. At SageOx, we believe the future of work is deeply human and collaborative. As agents take on execution, coordination, and routine work, people gain space for what only humans do well: creativity, judgment, relationships, the work of imagining, deciding, and creating together. Humans become not only more productive individually, but better at working with each other, leaning on their AI coworkers to carry out execution and raise the quality of how they collaborate. We're looking for strategic hires \- fearless, creative, independent thinkers \- that will shape the future of the company, and how work is done in the modern world. There's no trail yet. Pioneering and breaking trails is one of our company's core values. You're one of the first ten people cutting it. **Why this role exists** ------------------------ You'll be the first marketer at SageOx. There is no marketing team, no agency, no brand book with rules to follow \- you’ll be the brain behind all that. We’re looking for an AI\-pilled marketer who does not get defined by boundaries and applies creativity to push through the noise. SageOx is creating a new product category, and this role is part of the creation. A category doesn't exist until people have words for it. Part of your work is finding what resonates, learning how to explain it, and teaching the market to see what we see. That work happens in two places in public: social media, where builders are comparing notes on agents every day, and events, where they meet each other and decide what's worth their attention. Your job is to make SageOx present, legible, and connected in both. This role will morph over time as needs evolve. Your ultimate goal is to drive awareness of SageOx \- that can be measured by customer acquisition, engagement on social media, and broader ecosystem reach. **Social—be where the conversation is** --------------------------------------- * **Own SageOx's voice on X and LinkedIn.** Publish on cadence, every week: threads, posts, short video, and the occasional longer piece. The raw material comes from the founders, the team's own experiments with agents, customer stories, and shipped features; you turn it into things people actually read. * **Be a real presence, where builders compare notes.** Reddit, Hacker News, and the Discords and Slacks of the agent tools themselves — the Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and MCP communities. Show up as a person, be useful, know who the interesting voices are, and be one of them. * **Run launches.** When we ship something worth announcing, own the moment end to end — Hacker News, Product Hunt, the coordinated push across every channel, and the follow\-through in the comments. * **Amplify the founders and team.** Identify the highest\-impact platforms, podcasts, and moments for the founders and other team members to show up, get them there, and shape what they say so it lands. * **Bring outside\-in signal back.** What people are asking, what they're confused by, who's comparing us to what — surfaced to the core team continuously. What you hear in public is a deliverable, not a byproduct. **Events—put SageOx in the room** --------------------------------- * **Own event presence end to end.** Pick the events worth being at across San Francisco, Seattle, and other builder hubs, and decide how we show up — talk, demo, booth, dinner, sponsorship, or just being there. * **Host our own.** Meetups, hackathons, workshops, and small dinners for the teams building with agents. Start small and repeatable; grow what works. * **Turn every event into a pipeline.** Know who's coming, who we met, and what happened after. An event that produced no conversations worth following up on is an event we shouldn't repeat. * **Build the Seattle builder scene around us.** Seattle has fewer natural gathering points for agent\-heavy teams than San Francisco. Create some. **Systematize—measure, decide, repeat** --------------------------------------- * **Instrument everything.** Define what a good week looks like — qualified signups sourced, conversations started, follow\-ups from events — and report on it in a way the team can act on. * **Run experiments, not campaigns.** A new channel, a new format, a new event type: form a hypothesis, try it, measure it, keep it or kill it. A kill is a result. * **Use agents to scale yourself.** Research, drafting, monitoring, and reporting are all agent\-assisted here. Build those workflows for yourself — without outsourcing judgment or voice to the agents. * **Use SageOx daily** and market from lived use, not talking points. **How this person operates** ---------------------------- * Driven by curiosity, courageous in experimenting, humble in success, excited for what AI enables our customers to do. * Embodies the SageOx values \- you’ll be amongst the most recognized faces associated with the company. * Ships posts and events instead of producing marketing plans without execution. * Balances speed with taste. The goal is not maximum output; it is the right message to the right builders. In the age of AI slop, that often means editing and synthesizing rather than producing more. * Comfortable in a room full of engineers and builders, or in a thread full of skeptics. Asks sharp questions, listens, and changes direction when evidence contradicts the original idea. * Is resourceful and creative, finds solutions rather than waiting to inherit them. * Works well with founders and the team, communicates progress without excessive process, and makes the next decision clearer. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- We don't care which door you came through — social, community, developer relations, events, content, or building something of your own. We care that you can make a technical product legible to the people who need it and get them to show up. * **2–7 years in developer marketing, community, DevRel, social, or events** — for a technical product with a builder audience. The title matters less than the evidence: audiences you've grown, events you've run, and what happened after. * **Mission alignment:** believes deeply in what SageOx is building. Lives and breathes the product every day, all day long. * **Complete fluency with AI:** you use AI throughout your own work, and you're curious and knowledgeable about the ecosystem — emerging technologies, products, practices. The pitch is only credible from a practitioner. * **Has personally grown an audience, a community, or a channel somewhere.** Show us. * **Has run events people wanted to come back to** — from a 10\-person dinner to a hackathon. * **Technical enough to be credible:** you can explain what an MCP server is, demo the product, and follow an engineer's answer without needing it translated. * **Thinks deeply, communicates clearly, writes well:** AI slop is all around us — stand on your own thinking, clarity, and craft. Bonus if you're good on camera. * **Strong sense of ownership:** owns outcomes; makes things happen with limited resources; has a great sense of direction and prioritization amid the ambiguity of an early\-stage startup. * **Cultural fit:** embodies SageOx's values. **Great to have** ----------------- * Already connected to the builder scene in Seattle, San Francisco, and online — you know who to invite. * An existing audience of your own among builders. * Founder or early\-employee experience somewhere that grew fast. * Experience with open\-source products or developer communities. **Location — Seattle or San Francisco, in person** -------------------------------------------------- In person, five days a week. We move fast and the work benefits enormously from being in the room. For this role, the room is often an event, and half of them are in San Francisco — so either city works, and you'll spend real time in both.

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer (Seasonal)
jobs.description: #### **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Build a functional prototype of a mobile warehouse utility app designed to instantly count stacked warehouse supplies using ondevice artificial intelligence. * Train a lightweight, commercially viable custom object detection model (using frameworks like YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLONAS, or YOLOX) to recognize pallets, top frames, and layer pads across varying lighting conditions and angles. * Prepare and organize data by setting up a lightweight annotating workflow (e.g., Roboflow or CVAT) to label a dataset of 300500 images of inventory. * Export and optimize the trained model (via CoreML or TensorFlow Lite) to ensure it can run locally and offline inside the mobile application. * Build a simple, clean user interface (UI) that integrates the model to display realtime counting overlays and bounding boxes on a live camera feed or uploaded photo. * Cowork directly with one of the company owners to develop, iterate, and test the prototype. #### **Skills and Knowledge preferred:** * Solid foundations and strong skills in Python for training pipelines. * Experience with computer vision libraries (OpenCV, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) and 1\+ years of experience working with the YOLO architecture. * Proven experience embedding machine learning models onto edge devices, with knowledge of leveraging hardware acceleration (Apple Neural Engine, GPU) highly preferred. * Proficiency in mobile frameworks (Dart/Flutter, JavaScript/React Native, Swift, or Kotlin). * Familiarity with data annotation, augmentation, and model optimization. #### **Job Requirements:** * Authorization to work within the United States. * A problem solver capable of working independently and researching deployment bugs. * Candidates must provide a portfolio or GitHub link demonstrating past projects where an object detection model was successfully trained and deployed to production or an edge device (webcam, phone, Raspberry Pi, etc.) #### **Compensation \& Hours:** Start Date: Available immediately. Temporary Part\-Time Contract or Paid Internship (estimated 4 to 8 weeks). We are seeking applicants based in the Denver area who are available for frequent onsite collaboration. This role requires regular travel between our plant in Golden for team co\-working and hands\-on prototype testing. Ideal candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting area. Hourly Wage: $30/hour. Completion Bonus: A $5,000 bonus (based off completion) #### **About CTPS / Complete TransPack Solutions** Complete TransPack Solutions (CTPS) was founded in early 2017 to deliver on a single goal \- improve the returnable \& reusable packaging material asset supply chain by providing transparent and economically sustainable services to our customers. To accomplish our goal, we assembled a team of professionals that have individually devoted the majority of their careers to managing large\-scale packaging materials pools and programs to support rigid container manufacturing. Our Mission is to provide transport packaging material services and solutions supported by our commitments for continuous improvement, food safety and efficient processes to consistently exceed our customers' expectations

jobs.description: Subcontract Opportunity – Penetration Testing / Application Security Firm – MWBE/WBE/VOSB Firms Encouraged We are seeking an experienced Penetration Test Engineer to conduct independent security testing of a cloud\-based web and mobile application and its supporting APIs and infrastructure. The engineer will identify vulnerabilities, validate findings, assess risk, provide remediation recommendations, and prepare a professional penetration testing report suitable for submission to government/municipal clients. **Responsibilities** * Perform penetration testing of web applications, REST APIs, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure. * Test authentication, authorization, session management, access controls, APIs, and administrative interfaces. * Evaluate common vulnerabilities including OWASP Top 10 and API security risks. * Perform manual testing in addition to automated vulnerability scanning. * Verify vulnerabilities and minimize false positives. * Assign severity/risk ratings to findings. * Provide clear remediation recommendations to developers. * Conduct remediation/retesting after identified issues are corrected. * Produce an executive summary and detailed technical penetration\-test report. * Maintain testing evidence and documentation suitable for client or government review. * Handle all client/application information confidentially. * **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional penetration\-testing/application\-security experience. * Preferred certifications include **OSCP, OSWE, GPEN, GWAPT, PNPT, CEH or equivalent demonstrated experience** **Deliverables** * Penetration Test Plan * Vulnerability findings * Severity/risk ratings * Technical evidence * Remediation recommendations * Executive summary * Final penetration test report * Remediation/retest report * Experience testing SaaS, cloud, API and mobile environments. * Strong understanding of OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10\. * Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap and other industry\-standard security\-testing tools. * Ability to manually validate vulnerabilities. * Strong technical report\-writing skills. **Diversity Participation:** This opportunity is being advertised as part of our supplier\-diversity and subcontractor outreach efforts for a City of Pittsburgh project. Certified MBE, WBE, VOSB, DBE, and LGBTQIA\+\-owned firms are encouraged to respond. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * Reach, Scale \& Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research, and is responsible for driving the day\-to\-day operation of the Product \& Technology organization, including: project and portfolio management and tracking; organization\-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team. **Job Overview** ================ The Program Manager will be responsible for managing enterprise\-level projects and initiatives within the Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology (DEEP\&T) portfolio. This individual will work closely with various project owners to define the project team and assign responsibilities. The Program Manager will also be responsible for developing a consolidated view of the project, and for project deliverables including calendars, cross project dependencies, risk analysis, stakeholder coordination, and regular communication of status. Primary responsibilities include guiding process development at a project team level and managing high risk, high\-impact, strategic projects across a multi\-disciplinary, multi\-function group of technologists and business professionals. This requires experience communicating across audiences, effectively defining and utilizing escalation paths, and updating technology or business leaders. The program manager reports into the Global Program Management organization and will be responsible for driving delivery across the DEEP\&T. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Project Management Delivery** + Accountable for driving execution and delivery of projects or support programs from start to finish + Demonstrates a clear understanding of the project/program’s vision, objectives, scale and scope of work, expected outcomes, business value and impact, timelines, roadmaps, resource level requirements + Establishes strong partnerships and engagement with project stakeholders + Create full\-scale master project schedules and communication plans consisting of multiple teams or components + Supports governance practices and protocols to control and monitor the program/projects + Ensure proactive scheduling of key deliverables, milestones, and deliverable tasks + Establish project financial forecasts including resource plans and other expense plans + Actively participates in process and practice improvements in the project management environment and serves as a catalyst for project management excellence + Establishes strong partnerships and engagement with project stakeholders + Provides oversight to ensure critical day\-to\-day program/project deliverables progress forward to deliver specified requirements, objectives, and value + Identifies gaps in the project team’s accountability and ownership of deliverables + Foster a team environment of self\-organization, retrospect to learn and adapt with the goal of delivering the highest value to our guests and cast * **Financial Management** + Responsible for finance/budget responsibilities for projects and budgets (\<$1M). + Analyzes, measures and recognizes the financial impact of various project actions, participate in analyzing and using financial data to identify key project issues, and maintains budget tracking and monitors budget expenditures * **Status Reporting** + Prepares program/project status reports to demonstrate project overall health, key performance indicator (KPI), risk, issues, accomplishments, next steps, and escalation requests + Identifies and facilitates resolution of issues and risks on projects to meet commitments + Maintains data visualization elements to provide a graphic demonstration of project analytics and metrics * **Communication** + Leads with a win/win attitude with competing priorities and adapts to diverse personalities. Operates as an independent and dynamic project leader. Demonstrates influencing without direct authority + Facilitates project team meetings effectively, ensuring the desired outcomes are achieved + Distributes timely and effective project meeting updates and call to action updates across project teams + Demonstrates effective communication skills to facilitate project\-related conversations with technology senior leaders/managers/directors and service owners alike, and driving tasks and project dependencies to completion across multiple supporting teams + Escalates the need for guidance and support to direct manager effectively **Basic Qualifications:** ========================= * A minimum of 5\-years of applicable project management experience in a technology environment, preferably for a large company. * Proven experience with at least 5 years of experience in leading technology, multidisciplinary efforts across a large\-scale matrix organization * Experience in leading technology projects or multi\-threaded efforts * Able to lead project meetings and workshops driving commitments, accountability, and deliverables * Demonstrated critical thinking, and planning skills * Demonstrated experience developing and managing software development project plans * Exposure to software development lifecycle methodologies * Demonstrated analytical and problem\-solving skills to achieve business results * Strong interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a wide range of constituencies in a diverse corporate and client environment * Proven ability to deliver projects on time and on budget while communicating with teams and leadership * Ability to inspire, motivate and lead a team to produce quality work * Ability to communicate effectively to technology and business leaders * Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills * Exposure to modern software development and infrastructure tools, processes, and practices, including Jira/Confluence, Airtable, Smartsheets, etc. * End\-user experience in the use of modern program and project management tools, such as Smartsheet, Airtable, Jira/Confluence, etc. * Exposure to a wide range of productivity tools, including collaboration software (e.g., MS Teams), and standard MS Office tools (e.g., Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, OneDrive). * BA/BS in business, computer science preferred or other technical field or appropriate work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * Prior Disney experience is preferred. The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $129,300 \- $173,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Como HR** Como HR is a third\-party fractional HR firm based in Los Angeles. We serve healthcare and behavioral healthcare organizations: behavioral health and SUD treatment providers, medical groups, occupational medicine, urgent care, surgical centers, home health, hospice, and dental practices. Our clients operate under layered compliance obligations. Federal rules, state rules, licensing bodies, and accrediting bodies all stack on top of each other, and every one of them attaches to a specific person, on a specific date, with a specific document. Most firms in our space run that on spreadsheets. We are building software instead. **About The Role** We are building the Como HR platform: the system our HR reps and our clients both live in every day. It tracks every employee at every client facility, resolves which documents each of them owes based on role, worker classification, state and facility, routes those documents out for signature, and escalates them before they expire. A working prototype already exists and covers most major surfaces. This role takes it from prototype to production system. You would be an early engineering hire. That means you get real ownership of real features very quickly, you sit close to the people who actually do the HR work, and you will see what you build get used within days rather than quarters. It also means the work is broad, the specs are sometimes a conversation rather than a ticket, and you need to be comfortable with that. **What You Will Work On** \- **The requirements engine.** Given a person, a role, a worker classification (1099 vs W\-2\), a state and a facility, determine what documents they owe and when. Effective\-dated, so a rule change does not silently rewrite history. \- **Template composition.** Federal core plus state pack plus facility packs, composed into a live requirement set, with edits at the template level propagating correctly to every account using it. \- **Two portals, one truth.** An internal rep\-facing portal and a client\-facing portal over the same data, with deliberate rules about what is mirrored and what is internal only. \- **Integrations.** DocuSign for document routing and status, Gmail for notifications, Google Calendar for deadlines and scheduling. \- **Reporting and compliance visibility.** Matrix views that stay usable at 100\+ employees against 60\+ document requirements per facility. \- **The boring, load\-bearing parts.** Data modeling, migrations, auth and permissions, audit trails, tests, and the harnesses that keep all of the above honest. **Our Stack** React on the front end. Python and Node.js in the tooling and validation layer today, with the production backend architecture still an open decision you would help make. Integrations against the DocuSign, Gmail and Google Calendar APIs. We are not dogmatic about frameworks and we do not expect you to have used ours. **What We Are Looking For** **Required** \- BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Recent graduates encouraged; this role is designed for someone at the start of their career. \- Solid fundamentals: data structures, relational data modeling, HTTP and REST, version control with Git. \- Working proficiency in at least one modern language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, C\#) and willingness to work in whichever the problem calls for. \- Enough front\-end capability to build and modify React components, whether from coursework, internships, or personal projects. \- Clear written communication. You will be writing specs and documentation, not just code. \- Genuine care about correctness. A missed expiration date in this system is a client's compliance failure, not a cosmetic bug. **AI fluency (required)** We build with AI\-assisted tooling as a default, not as a novelty. We are looking for someone who already works this way and can go further with it. \- Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar, and good judgment about where they help and where they do not. \- Understanding of how LLMs actually work at a practical level: prompting, context windows, structured output, evaluation, and where hallucination risk lives. \- Interest in building AI features into the product itself. Document intake and classification, drafting, and intelligent compliance review are all on the roadmap. \- Bonus: exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, or fine\-tuning. **Nice to have** \- Internship or project experience with multi\-tenant SaaS. \- Exposure to any regulated domain: healthcare, HR, finance, legal. \- Experience integrating third\-party APIs with real authentication and webhook handling. \- Anything you built and shipped that people other than your professor used. What we offer \- Direct mentorship from the principals, with no layers in between. \- Meaningful ownership of a core product from an early stage. \- A domain that is genuinely intricate. If you like systems where the rules are complicated and getting them right matters, this is that. \- *\[Benefits, PTO, equity or bonus structure to be added.]* **How To Apply** Tell us about one thing you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. If you have a GitHub, portfolio, or anything shipped and public, include it. We would rather see a small project you can explain deeply than a long list of technologies you have touched once. *Como HR is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.* Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Tell us about one thing you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. If you have a GitHub, portfolio, or anything shipped and public, include it. We would rather see a small project you can explain deeply than a long list of technologies you have touched once. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90025

jobs.title: Software Engineer Co-op 2027
jobs.description: ### **Who We’re Looking For** Megazone Cloud is looking for a **Software Engineer Co\-op** who is a "builder" at heart and eager to kickstart their career in a high\-growth, global environment. You are passionate about deep\-diving into software development, cloud architecture, and solving ambiguous, high\-stakes technical problems. As a Co\-op, you won't just be watching from the sidelines. You will be a key part of our internal and client\-facing teams, contributing to technical discovery, designing full\-stack solutions, and collaborating with our senior experts to execute a clear vision. You are a fast learner with a thirst for knowledge and a desire to see your code make a real\-world impact. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Collaborate and Build:** Work directly with senior engineers and our U.S. tech team to translate complex business requirements into functional software features and services. * **Own the Full Stack:** Design, develop, test, and deploy software solutions, gaining hands\-on experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, or Go. * **Be a Client\-Facing Contributor:** Participate in technical discussions and client meetings, effectively communicating progress on tickets, improvements, and deliverables. * **Solve the Unsolvable:** Assist in troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to cloud infrastructure, applications, and services. * **Drive Modern Practices:** Help implement monitoring solutions and lean into DevOps best practices, including CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code. * **Learn and Multiply:** Actively participate in design reviews and knowledge\-sharing sessions, leveraging our "force multiplier" culture to level up your skills and the team’s output. ### **What You Bring (Requirements)** * **Educational Foundation:** Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Technical Curiosity:** Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., **Python**, **Java**, **JavaScript**, **Go**) and a strong grasp of programming/scripting fundamentals. * **Cloud Ambition:** Exposure to or a deep interest in major cloud platforms (e.g., **AWS**, **Azure**) and modern data ecosystems. * **DevOps Mindset:** Foundational knowledge of DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation. * **Communication Excellence:** Ability to translate technical concepts for different audiences and a desire to engage in a professional services/consulting environment. * **Startup Mentality:** A strategic "builder" mindset, a sense of ownership, and the agility to manage multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Bonus Points (Nice\-to\-Haves)** * Previous internship or project experience in a **Professional Services** or consulting environment. * Experience with **GenAI**, **MLOps**, or specialized data tools (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake). * Relevant AWS or cloud\-provider certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner). **NOTE:** *We are unable to provide sponsorship for this position.* ### **Why You'll Love It Here** * **Our Product is Our People:** We live by this. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your growth is our growth. * **True Servant Leadership:** Our CTO leads with a "force multiplier" philosophy. Management is here to empower you and clear roadblocks, not to micromanage. We won't ask you to do anything we're not willing to do ourselves. * **Flat Organization, Real Impact:** Your voice and designs will directly shape our technical roadmap and our clients' success. You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems. * **A "Learn\-from\-it" Culture:** We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures. We seek diverse talent who are ready to make an immediate impact. We believe that innovation thrives when teams are built with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you are excited by this mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. **Megazone Cloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires.**

jobs.title: Sr. Five9 CCaaS Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: About Lion Mountain Lion Mountain is a professional services firm focused entirely on Five9 contact center implementations and migrations. We help mid\-market and enterprise customers move from legacy on\-premise systems and competing CCaaS platforms onto Five9, design the solution that actually fits their business, and stay with them through go\-live and beyond. We were Five9’s High Performance Demand Partner of 2025, and are on track to repeat for 2026\. We are a small, senior team that wins on depth, not volume. Our customers hire us because of our in\-depth Five9 knowledge, we treat their CRM and telephony stack like our own, and we do not hand work off to junior resources. Every engineer here owns customer outcomes end to end. The Role We are hiring an Implementation Engineer who can act as the lead Five9 solution architect on customer engagements. You will own implementations from discovery through go\-live: scoping the work, designing the call flows and integrations, configuring the Five9 environment, integrating it with the customer’s CRM, training their team, and standing behind it after launch. This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will be the technical expert in the room — the person the customer’s operations lead, IT lead, and CX leader all turn to. You will be backed by a small team of senior peers, with room to shape how we deliver as we grow. What You’ll DoLead Five9 implementations end to end * Run discovery workshops with customer business and technical stakeholders to capture current\-state contact center flows, pain points, and target outcomes. * Translate business requirements into a Five9 solution design — IVR / IVA flows, ACD and skills\-based routing, queues, dispositions, campaigns, reporting, WFM/WFO, and quality management. * Configure and deploy Five9: agent profiles, skills, campaigns, IVR scripts, prompts, DNIS / ANI mapping, dial plans, dispositions, supervisor and reporting setup. * Lead migration from legacy platforms (Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco, Twilio Flex, Amazon Connect, etc.) into Five9 with minimal disruption. * Own UAT, cutover planning, training, and go\-live and post go\-live support. Architect and build CRM integrations * Design and implement CRM integrations between Five9 and customer systems, including Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ImproveIt360, ServiceNow, etc.. and proprietary platforms. * Configure screen pop, click\-to\-dial, automated activity logging, and workflow triggers between Five9 and the CRM. * Where adapters are not enough, build custom integrations using the Five9 Agent API, REST/SOAP web services, VCC Agent Desktop Toolkit, and webhooks. * Partner with customer admins and developers to make the integration sustainable after we leave. Serve as the solution architect on each engagement * Own the technical design document and architecture diagrams for each project. * Make trade\-off decisions on routing strategy, IVR design, reporting model, security model, and integration approach — and clearly explain those trade\-offs to the customer. * Anticipate failure modes: telephony carrier handoffs, peak\-volume scaling, disaster recovery, security and compliance constraints (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Quality\-check the build before it ever goes in front of the customer. Be the trusted technical voice with the customer * Lead status calls, design reviews, and executive readouts. * Translate fluently between contact center operations, IT, and executive leadership audiences. * Push back constructively when a customer ask will create long\-term pain — and bring an alternative. Make Lion Mountain better * Contribute to our implementation playbooks, reusable templates, and integration patterns. * Mentor peers on tricky Five9 features and integration approaches. * Share what you learn in the field so the whole team gets sharper with every engagement. What We’re Looking ForRequired * Hands\-on Five9 implementation experience. You have personally configured and deployed Five9 for production customers — not just observed or supported it. * Deep familiarity with core Five9 capabilities: IVR / IVA, ACD, campaigns (inbound, outbound, blended), skills\-based routing, Supervisor, reporting, WFA and APIs. * Working knowledge of Five9 Studio 7 / IVR scripting and the Five9 Agent Desktop Plus / VCC Agent. * Experience integrating Five9 with at least 2 major CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ServiceNow, or similar) in production. * Strong understanding of contact center fundamentals: queueing, occupancy, AHT, SLAs, abandonment, blended outbound, compliance dialing (TCPA), call recording requirements. * Solid grasp of telephony concepts: SIP, DIDs, toll\-free, number porting, carrier handoffs, codecs, network requirements for VoIP quality. * Comfort with web technologies used in integrations: REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, webhooks, basic JavaScript. Reading and writing API calls is part of the job. * Excellent customer\-facing communication. You can run a workshop, write a design doc, and present to a VP — in the same week. * Self\-direction. You can own a project end to end without daily oversight. * US\-based and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. Strongly preferred * Five9 Professional Services or Five9 Partner experience. * Five9 certifications (Implementation, Administrator, IVA, or specialty tracks). * Salesforce Service Cloud admin experience or Salesforce certification. * Experience migrating customers from Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco UCCE/UCCX, or Amazon Connect onto Five9\. * Experience with Five9 Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, and AI / NLU concepts. * Experience in regulated industries: financial services, healthcare, insurance, or BPO. * Light scripting in Python or Node.js for integration glue. Pay: From $45\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.description: Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO) **A.C.E. Platform \| Fully Remote \| Founding Executive Opportunity** Build the Technology Behind a Membership\-Powered Movement A.C.E. is seeking a **Founding Chief Technology Officer** to help take an already developing platform through launch, stabilization, growth, and ultimately scale. A.C.E. is: **Membership Powered.** **Impact Focused.** **Faith Rooted.** **Community Driven.** We are building a platform designed to bring people, ideas, resources, opportunities, businesses, organizations, and communities together in ways that create measurable growth and meaningful impact. A.C.E. is openly Christian in the values and principles behind the organization, but membership and employment are not limited by faith. We are intentionally building a welcoming platform for people from different backgrounds who believe in growth, opportunity, connection, purpose, and making a difference. This is not an idea sitting on a whiteboard. The A.C.E. website is functional. The membership platform has been established. Core systems including membership functionality, referrals, points and rewards have already been developed, and backend development is actively underway. Now we are looking for the person who can help take what has been built and get it fully across the finish line. THE IMMEDIATE MISSION The first responsibility of the Founding CTO is straightforward: **Get A.C.E. technically ready to launch, accept members, process activity reliably, and support growth.** At this stage, we need someone who is willing to be highly hands\-on. That means reviewing what already exists, identifying what remains unfinished, solving technical problems, improving systems where necessary, connecting pieces that need to work together, and helping make sure the platform is secure, stable and launch\-ready. As A.C.E. grows, this role is expected to evolve from hands\-on technical execution into full executive leadership of the company’s technology operations. WHAT YOU’LL OWN Responsibilities may include: · Reviewing the existing A.C.E. platform, website, backend architecture and supporting systems · Completing and improving launch\-critical development · Ensuring membership registration and account functionality operate properly · Managing and improving referral, points, rewards and engagement systems · Supporting payment processing and membership\-related integrations · Managing APIs, databases, hosting, cloud infrastructure and deployment · Troubleshooting technical issues and solving problems directly · Evaluating scalability, performance and reliability · Establishing security, privacy, backup and recovery standards · Identifying technical risks before they become business problems · Supporting development of future web and mobile applications · Creating a practical technology roadmap based on A.C.E.’s growth · Evaluating and selecting vendors, platforms and technical partners · Working directly with the Founder \& CEO on product development and priorities · Supporting analytics and data infrastructure as membership grows · Eventually recruiting and managing developers, engineers, contractors and technology partners · Building the technology department you will ultimately lead THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR We are not looking for someone whose primary goal is simply obtaining a C\-suite title. We need a **builder.** Someone who can look at an objective, assess what already exists, identify what is missing, and move the project forward. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, technically capable, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to work directly inside the technology before eventually leading others. Experience may include: · Full\-stack development · Web applications · Mobile applications · Backend systems · APIs and integrations · Databases · Cloud infrastructure · Membership or subscription platforms · Payment systems · Cybersecurity · SaaS or marketplace platforms · Startup or early\-stage technology environments You do not need to personally be the strongest engineer in every possible discipline. You do need enough technical depth to understand the systems, make sound decisions, diagnose problems, build where necessary, and know when specialized expertise should be brought in. FOUNDING EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION This is a **founding executive opportunity** designed for someone who wants to help build A.C.E. during its launch stage and grow into a long\-term C\-suite leadership position as the platform scales. A.C.E. is intentionally being built through **membership growth and internally generated revenue rather than outside investment.** Compensation for this role is designed to **increase progressively as defined launch, performance, membership, revenue and profitability milestones are achieved.** Rather than requiring the selected executive to wait until A.C.E. reaches full scale before compensation begins, the intention is to establish a **staged compensation structure** that allows earnings to begin incrementally as the company reaches agreed benchmarks. This creates a direct connection between execution, company growth and compensation. A strong candidate who helps move A.C.E. from development to launch quickly, stabilizes the platform, supports successful member acquisition and helps the company begin generating sustainable revenue may therefore reach paid compensation milestones sooner.
