jobs.title: VISO
jobs.description: Position Description: **COMPANY PROFILE** Our company helps our clients with technology and IT security, so they can focus on running their business, law firm, school, or medical practice. Big picture \- We do all sorts of things, from designing networks to providing ongoing maintenance; we are the company that our clients call for everything from basic computer support to hosted solutions, to network design, to security and compliance management. Some clients want to push the envelope with new technologies, and some want to keep costs to a minimum. We are onsite approximately 5% of the time and provide remote support, security auditing, compliance management, consulting to internal team members and clients from one of our offices or your home office 95% of the time. We typically work around 40\-45 hours per week, although sometimes we work longer and later. (In IT support, things can go crazy, and we must work late sometimes). With the right monitoring tools, standardization, automation, and processes in place, we work to eliminate the crazy the best we can. Our office support hours are 8 AM until 6 PM. We would be lying if we said those were cushy hours playing PlayStation or watching Netflix while listening to clients talk about security issues on the phone. That's not our day \- we are busting it to help our clients and move on to the next problem. We have awesome benefits for an organization our size as well: excellent compensation, paid time off, 401k match, phone/internet allowance, sabbatical, bereavement, the list goes on and on. We are looking for great people who are excited about technology, security and enjoy dealing directly with clients. We're fanatics about client service, we run a responsive and professional operation, and we love what we do. (OK, we don't love it every day, but most days we do.) We're not looking for people who can't handle security issues independently or who hate working with other humans. We are looking to build our team with people who want to learn about the latest IT security trends and want to contribute to our team. Every day is different over here, and you must learn quickly and go with it. Now for the boring requirements . . . **Position Summary** The Virtual Information Security Officer (vISO) is responsible for providing strategic cybersecurity leadership and guidance to assigned customers. This role oversees security governance, risk management, compliance activities, and technical security analysis within customer environments. The vISO ensures customers maintain an effective security posture aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, including managing AI and LLM security risks. The vISO position will report to Cantey Tech’s Information Security Officer. **Required Duties \& Responsibilities** **Security Governance \& Customer Leadership** * Act as the primary security advisor for customer stakeholders, providing guidance on risk, policy, and security strategy. * Evaluate customer environments to identify risks and recommend prioritized remediation strategies. * Complete monthly security scorecards for assigned customers. * Lead monthly internal and customer\-facing scorecard reviews in partnership with the vCIO team. * Manage customer security awareness programs, including onboarding, deployment, and reporting. * Develop and maintain customer IT security policies with annual reviews. * Assist with external or third\-party security audits required for customers. * Assist with best practices and guidance for securing AI and LLM usage. **Risk Assessment \& Vulnerability Management** * Review vulnerability assessment results and penetration test reports; coordinate remediation plans with engineers and service teams. * Analyze security\-related data including firewall logs, endpoint alerts, content filtering logs, email security reports, user activity and authentication logs, and backup platforms. * Establish, maintain and update security baselines across customer systems and appliances. * Establish, maintain and update AI and LLM security and permission baselines for customer use. **Technical Security Support** * Assist with escalated security\-related service tickets and customer concerns. * Review open security tickets weekly to provide timely guidance or next steps. * Evaluate requests for security exceptions (e.g., content filtering or endpoint protection exceptions). * Lead incident response investigations and jobs.description: Cyber Product Lead Capital One is seeking a product owner to help deliver game\-changing cybersecurity solutions based on threat, data, and design thinking. At Capital One, we believe in the values of Excellence and Doing the Right Thing. We are a technology\-oriented company delivering financial products to market through modern technology and constant innovation at a massive scale. Part of that innovation is leveraging technology to deliver the best cybersecurity solutions for our business. As a Product Owner, you will be accountable for contributing to and delivering upon the strategic agenda for our core cyber products to drive meaningful progress for our customers and our business. While your initial focus will center on Secure AI agents initiative for the enterprise, this role is designed for a fungible product leader who can adapt and pivot across general cybersecurity capabilities enterprise\-wide. In this capacity, you will drive product vision into our development teams, translate vision into delivery objectives, provide customer\-informed guidance to shape products, and work with cross\-functional teams to deliver well\-managed and sustainable features that bring that vision to life. You will use your deep technical knowledge and subject matter expertise in cybersecurity and systems engineering to drive impactful improvements to our cyber capabilities. What You’ll Do * End\-to\-End Cyber Product Ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle (discovery, vision, delivery, and adoption) of core cybersecurity products across multiple technical security domains. * Initial High\-Impact Focus Areas: + *Security Monitoring:* Partner with SOC and threat detection teams to advance telemetry collection, log analytics, and threat\-hunting capabilities. + *Secure AI Agents:* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to integrate security controls, guardrails, and risk mitigations into AI/ML development pipelines. * Adaptable Backlog \& Technical Execution: Manage, groom, and prioritize a healthy product backlog in Jira/SAFe environments, balancing new capabilities, operational risk reduction, technical debt, and system reliability (SRE). * Cross\-Functional Advisory: Serve as the subject matter expert bridging executive leadership, compliance, engineering, and software development teams to drive security integration into everyday workflows. * Metrics \& Customer\-Centric Design: Leverage analytics, telemetry metrics, and internal developer feedback to measure product adoption, evaluate threat\-reduction ROI, and continuous delivery health. About You * You believe that a core component of security's role is to enable the business, not just to secure it, and the solutions you bring to life are aligned to the needs of our developer community, customers, and business partners. * You thrive in working in a fast\-paced, technologically forward\-leaning environment and are not afraid to push the boundaries of security capabilities. * You seek to create enduring value by delivering reusable, extensible, and resilient cybersecurity capabilities to address the evolving threat landscape. * You actively solve for cyber technical challenges in collaboration with engineering. * You are naturally curious and stay on top of emerging trends and threats, including modern AI/ML security vectors. * You have a comprehensive understanding of iterative software delivery to connect effectively and in a meaningful way with software and platform engineers. * You seek to understand the business and technology landscape and cross\-functional dependencies to inform product vision and integration with larger organizational goals. * You are a clear thinker, thrive in working across teams, and are an expert in dealing with ambiguity. * You understand and track key metrics on security, resilience, and performance for your product(s) and understand levers that drive these metrics. * You have strong consulting and analytical skills and a risk management mindset. * You have the ability to foster collaborative, open working relationships with technology partners and other stakeholders. * You demonstrate balanced judgment in decisions, incorporate risk factors accordingly, and maintain a strong bias for action. jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering (Remote - eligible)
jobs.description: Director, AI Engineering (Remote \- eligible) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **About the Team** This team owns the infrastructure layer between applications and foundation models: model access, routing, reliability, security integration, observability, and cost management behind a single governed interface. Product teams build on the platform instead of integrating with model providers directly, which means the enterprise adopts new model capability once, centrally, rather than many times over. Sitting in the request path for every AI\-powered application makes latency, reliability, and efficiency company\-level outcomes rather than local ones. This team also owns a measurement and attribution layer that makes consumption legible to the optimization capabilities that act on it, including intelligent routing, caching, context optimization, and capacity planning. The objective is cost per unit of business outcome, not spend reduction in isolation. jobs.description: Manager, Data Scientist \- US Card (Upmarket Acquisitions) Data is at the center of everything we do. jobs.title: Junior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **What We Do** CarParts.com is the go\-to eCommerce platform for auto care and maintenance. We provide drivers with quality parts at competitive prices and enable them to schedule appointments with trusted mechanics directly through our website. Using world\-class design principles and the latest technologies, we deliver a fast, intuitive digital experience backed by our company\-owned national distribution network. With over 1,000 employees worldwide, we are scaling rapidly, fueled by our most recent strategic partnership and $35 million investment. This positions us for the next phase of growth as we continue to empower drivers along their journey. **Our Culture** At CarParts.com, our culture goes beyond our core values of Safety First, Customer Focused, and Commitment to Excellence. We are a performance\-driven, data\-focused, and fast\-paced team where results matter and winning is expected. * Hungry \& Hardworking: We set ambitious goals, measure progress with clear metrics, and hold ourselves accountable to deliver results. * Promote from Within: We reward top performers with opportunities for growth and advancement. * Collaborative \& In\-Person: We believe the best ideas and fastest execution happen face\-to\-face. \- High Standards: We move quickly, pay attention to details, and dig deep \- whether it’s analyzing contracts, aggregating complex scenarios, or building clear, data\-driven presentations. * No Passengers: We value grit, ownership, and the relentless pursuit of results **Summary of Role/Position** We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to join our team and play a key role in building, deploying, and advancing our machine learning and AI systems. This person will work cross\-functionally to design, train, and ship models and agentic AI pipelines that power areas such as search, recommendations, content generation, customer segmentation, and conversational AI, owning the work end to end from SQL and data preparation through production deployment.**YOU****WILL:*** Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models (e.g., ranking, retrieval, embeddings, NER, classification) that power search, recommendations, and other product experiences * Build and maintain agentic AI pipelines that orchestrate LLMs, tools, and retrieval to automate data enrichment, content generation, and internal workflows * Write efficient SQL and Python to build training datasets, features, and evaluation sets from large\-scale clickstream, catalog, and transaction data * Own the full model lifecycle: version code and models in GitHub, automate training and deployment through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, and monitor model quality in production * Collaborate with engineering, product, and marketing teams to integrate models and AI services into production systems * Evaluate model performance with offline metrics and online A/B tests, and iterate based on results * Stay current with advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, agents, and representation learning, and identify opportunities to apply emerging techniques **YOU MUST HAVE:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field with 2 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or a related role, or a Master's degree in one of those fields * Strong ML fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, loss functions and optimization, regularization, evaluation metrics, and experiment design * Hands\-on deep learning experience training and fine\-tuning models with PyTorch; familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks * Proficiency in Python and SQL, including writing and optimizing queries over large datasets * Proficiency with Git and GitHub workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins for automated testing, training, and deployment * Experience building LLM\-based or agentic AI pipelines (prompt design, tool use, RAG, evaluation) * Experience working with large datasets and cloud platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS, GCP) * Good communication skills and ability to explain technical findings to non\-technical stakeholders * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Marketing, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field **NICE TO HAVE:*** Experience with e\-commerce or retail product data * Experience with search and retrieval systems (e.g., OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, vector search, learning\-to\-rank) * Familiarity with MLOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, Docker, model serving and monitoring) and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, MCP) * Experience with end\-to\-end model development, from prototyping to production A reasonable salary estimate based on education, experience, and geographic location is: $105,000\-$115,000 **Equal Opportunity Employer***CarParts.com is an* *equal\-opportunity* *employer. We combine deep AI research expertise with the scale and operational excellence of Splunk and Cisco’s global engineering capabilities. Our work spans networking, security, observability, and customer experience, designing and deploying foundation models that enhance reliability, strengthen security, prevent downtime, and deliver predictive insights across Splunk Observability, Security, and Platform at enterprise scale. You’ll thrive in our collaborative team environment, where your innovative ideas are valued and you’re challenged to create elegant solutions to complex problems. You will actively participate in the design and development of new features and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our architecture. You'll quickly grasp complex concepts and leverage your extensive experience to identify areas for improvement and drive impactful change. ***This role is a remote full time position and can be based anywhere in the US.*** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and Develop: Build and maintain scalable, healthcare AI applications using Java and React. * Architect Solutions: Design robust, performant, and maintainable system architectures, focusing on cloud application best practices. * Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into effective solutions. * Optimize Performance: Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks to ensure high application availability and efficiency. * Innovate: Contribute to the development of cutting\-edge features leveraging the power of AI and machine learning. * Code Review: Participate in code reviews to foster knowledge sharing and best practices across the team. * Maintain Quality: Write thorough tests and documentation to ensure code quality and maintainability. * Deployment and Support: Assist with the development, deployment, and support of on\-prem and cloud\-based solutions, spanning from internal development to customer production systems. **What You Have** ----------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent extensive experience * Professional software development experience with a focus on full\-stack development, including backend APIs, frontend UI, system integrations, and user authentication. * Deep expertise in Java programming, including experience designing and implementing highly optimized and scalable architectures. * Experience with building enterprise\-grade full\-stack applications using Spring Boot, React, UX design frameworks, and relational and document databases. * Proven experience in developing and deploying cloud\-based applications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). * Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and experience building and consuming REST APIs. * Strong experience with relational databases, including Oracle, PostgreSQL, and document databases, including MongoDB and derivatives. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bonus points for: + Experience in the healthcare domain, including HL7 and FHIR. + Experience with AI/ML concepts and frameworks. + Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. + Working knowledge of containers (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes). Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, GenAI Evaluation Framework
jobs.description: **About the AI Accelerator** The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof\-of\-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production. **About the Role** Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder\-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself. The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF. **What You Will Own** * **GEF product roadmap.** Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it. * **Enablement queue.** You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved. * **Framework build.** You implement and maintain LLM\-as\-judge, rule\-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human\-labeled baselines. * **Evaluation pipelines.** You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry. * **Golden datasets.** You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on. * **Onboarding and adoption.** You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self\-serve. * **Quality reporting.** You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost\-per\-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require. * **Agent instrumentation.** You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines. * A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against. * Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support. * Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly. * Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them. **Who You Will Work With** Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group. Across Cox Automotive: engineering and product teams at VinSolutions, Autotrader, Manheim, Dealertrack, and other business units as they onboard, plus Platform Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise AI, Security, and FinOps. **Required Qualifications** * Two or more years of professional machine learning engineering experience with a Bachelor's Degree, OR up to two years combined with a Master's Degree in a quantitative field. * Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future. * Must currently live within a commutable distance to Atlanta to be considered. * Experience owning the direction of a technical product, internal tool, library, or platform used by other teams. Formal product ownership is welcome, and so is having been the de facto owner of something other engineers depended on. * Ability to maintain a roadmap, set priorities among competing requests, and explain the tradeoffs to both engineers and product stakeholders. * Strong Python, with working habits around testing, version control, code review, and continuous integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompting, API integration, retrieval, or agent frameworks. * Working knowledge of measurement concepts such as sampling, inter\-rater agreement, precision and recall, or comparative testing. * Experience with cloud services, ideally AWS, and with building data pipelines. * Strong written communication, including documentation, roadmap updates, and reporting to senior stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Formal product ownership or technical product management experience for developer tools, infrastructure, or ML platforms. * Experience with evaluation tooling such as DeepEval, AWS Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, Langfuse, or RAGAS. * Experience in a federated organization where adoption is voluntary and the product must win on merit. * Experience with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry or Datadog. * Exposure to model risk, AI governance, or work in a regulated environment. * Prior work at the intersection of data science teams and product or platform engineering. USD 92,300\.00 \- 153,900\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $92,300\.00 \- $153,900\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality & Automation
jobs.description: Crum \& Forster Company Overview: Travel Insured International (TII), a Crum \& Forster company, is hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality \& Automation. Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident \& Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and end\-to\-end satisfaction for all customers. Job Description: This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on quality—often referred to in the industry as an SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test). This role writes code to test software: rather than executing test cases manually, you build the automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that verify quality at scale, blending deep software development skills with a quality\-first mindset. You will own TII's test strategy and automation platform as a senior individual contributor. The mission is to transform a largely manual testing practice into an AI\-accelerated, CI/CD\-integrated automation capability—eliminating any regression bottleneck that slows releases, while elevating quality across our Agile Release Trains. We welcome candidates from either a software engineering or quality engineering background. Whether you're a talented full\-stack engineer with an automation\-first mindset or a quality engineer who codes, what matters most is strong hands\-on engineering, the ability to build scalable frameworks, and a genuine passion for shipping high\-quality software. This is a build\-it\-yourself role: you will design and code scalable automation frameworks, integrate testing into Azure DevOps pipelines, introduce AI\-assisted test generation and predictive quality analytics, and uplift the standards and output of a distributed employee/offshore testing team. You will own quality strategy and the automation platform while partnering with engineering and product leadership—embedding quality earlier (shift\-left) and making it a shared, measurable engineering discipline in support of TII's growth target and expansion into new distribution channels. **What you will do:** **Quality Strategy** * Own and evolve TII's test strategy, quality standards, and risk\-based testing approach across the Agile Release Trains. * Define shift\-left quality practices that embed testing into design and development. * Establish release quality gates and standards in partnership with engineering and product leadership. * Lead root cause analysis to systematically minimize production defects. * Ensure adherence to relevant industry standards (ISTQB, ISO) and regulatory/compliance needs in a regulated insurance environment. **Test Automation \& Engineering** * Design, build, and own the automation platform—web (Cypress/Playwright or comparable), mobile, API (GraphQL/REST via Postman), and regression—integrated into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. * Architect reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation components and frameworks, including data\-driven and keyword\-driven designs. * Drive the conversion of manual testing to automated, continuous testing, systematically increasing regression coverage. * Establish API/contract testing for GraphQL and REST services and validate service integrations. * Introduce performance/load and security testing aligned to the platform's scale and resilience goals. * Own test data management, including compliant synthetic test data for PII\-sensitive scenarios. **Quality Engineering Excellence** * Champion quality as a shared engineering responsibility—embedding testability standards into how software is designed and built. * Partner with engineering architecture to align testing with architectural standards and DevSecOps practices. * Define and make visible quality metrics—escaped\-defect rate, automated coverage, test flakiness, and cycle\-time impact—through reporting and dashboards. * Drive measurable reduction of the regression bottleneck. **Release \& Delivery Quality** * Provide quality signals and gate recommendations into the release process. * Ensure regression and critical\-path coverage give teams the confidence to release faster. * Oversee functional, regression, performance, security, and UAT testing across web, mobile, API, and data layers. **Leadership within the Team** * Co\-lead a small group of quality engineers, manual testers, and off shore test engineers. * Uplift and direct the distributed employee/offshore testing team—raising automation skills and standards, and converting manual capacity toward automation. * Mentor engineers and testers, demonstrating the leadership behaviors that support growth into a formal QE leadership role. * Establish onboarding, standards, and ways of working that scale across distribut including data\-driven and keyword\-driven automation designs. * Hands\-on API development or testing for GraphQL and REST (e.g., Postman) and validation of service integrations. * Proven experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions/Jenkins comparable). * Understanding of test strategy, risk\-based testing, and shift\-left practices in an Agile/Scrum environment. * Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP comparable). * Exposure to AI\-driven engineering or testing tools and methodologies. * Proven leadership or mentoring of distributed/offshore teams required. Formal people\-leadership experience a plus * ISTQB Advanced Level certification or equivalent (for quality\-background candidates) preferred. * Hands\-on experience developing automation or application code using GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted tooling preferred. * Experience with AI\-assisted test generation and/or predictive quality analytics preferred. * Performance/load testing (e.g., k6, JMeter) and API contract testing (e.g., Pact) preferred. * Test data management / synthetic data experience in a regulated (PII) environment preferred. * Full\-stack development experience (React/Angular, .NET Core, SQL/NoSQL) preferred. * Experience in insurance, travel, fintech, or SaaS preferred. What C\&F will bring to you: **What C\&F will bring to YOU:** * Competitive compensation package * Generous 401K employer match * Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching * Generous Paid Time Off * Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental \& vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing * A core C\&F tenant is owning your career development so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path * A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment * We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community **At C\&F you will BELONG** We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you require a special accommodation, please let us know. For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit https://www.cfins.com/onlineprivacypolicy/ca/noticeatcollection/ for more information. Crum \& Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $95,600 to a maximum of $179,600\. jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About Curative** Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first\-of\-its\-kind employer\-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent $150M in Series B funding and valuation at $1\.275B, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI\-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce. Our north star guides everything we do: healthcare only works when people can actually use it. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team. If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better. **Summary** We are hiring a Senior Software Test Engineer to help us deliver quickly with the right level of quality. If you're picturing test plans, sign\-off gates, and sprint ceremonies, this is not that job. At Curative, every engineer owns what they ship. Your job is to make that possible at speed. A big part of that is our AI agents, which do real operational work in production. We're investing in the evaluation layer to match: eval suites, regression harnesses, and systematic measurement. But the role is not only infrastructure. You'll work directly with business teams, become a domain expert in corners of our business, test the way real users work, and catch the gap between what was asked for and what was shipped. Some days you're writing an eval harness; some days you're hunting a bug an operations teammate can feel but can't pin down; some days you're shaping what gets built next. You'll advise on quality concerns, and you'll jump in and fix things yourself: same day, not next sprint. If ambiguity sounds stressful, this is the wrong role. If moving between code, product, and people in the same afternoon sounds like the best part of the job, keep reading. **How we build** At Curative, AI writes most of the code. Engineers direct it, using agentic AI coding tools as the primary development surface: setting context, making the decisions the AI cannot, and keeping the bar high on what ships. This is not a role for someone who wants to hand\-roll every line, nor for someone who will accept whatever the AI produces. We want the engineer in between: fundamentals strong enough to catch a wrong answer fast, discipline to review every diff, and ambition to drive several times the output of a traditional IC. **What you'll own** * The eval platform. Harnesses, datasets, graders, and CI integration that let teams measure agent behavior: task success, tool\-use correctness, drift, latency, cost. You'll build it and make it the thing teams reach for because it's useful, not because a process says so. * Hands\-on, exploratory testing. You test the way members, operations teams, and providers actually use the product, end to end, weird paths included, and find what breaks before the real world does. * Validating we built the right thing. You sit with business stakeholders, understand the real workflow, and catch the gap between what was asked for and what was shipped. * Domain expertise. You go deep enough on our business that teams pull you in because you understand the workflow, not just the code. * Production signal and bug hunting. Traces, failure taxonomies, and dashboards that turn "the agent seems off" into a specific finding. In incidents you reproduce the failure, find the root cause, and fix it or hand off a diagnosis so precise the fix is obvious. * Product judgment when needed. Sometimes there's no PM in the room. You can write the requirement, propose the behavior, make the call, and hand it back gracefully when the right owner shows up. * Prioritization under chaos. Finite hours, wide surface. You decide where effort goes first, which agents carry the most risk, and which failures are expensive versus merely embarrassing, and you defend that call. **What we're looking for** **Foundational skills** * 5\+ years in software quality, testing, or engineering with real range. You've written automation and done serious exploratory testing, moving between them as the problem demands. * Real fluency with LLM evaluation. Golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge, programmatic graders, regression suites for prompts and agent loops. You can point to evals that caught real problems. * Hands\-on experience with AI agents and the ways they fail: silent drift, tool misuse, compounding errors. * A tester's instincts. You find the bug nobody else does, and you have the track record to prove it. * Debugging depth. Logs, traces, queries, production forensics. You find the bug and can fix it yourself in Python or TypeScript. * Fluency with business stakeholders. You can run a session with a non\-technical operations lead, extract what they actually need, and leave them feeling heard. * Comfort with ambiguity and speed. You've been effective without mature processes. You don't need a ticket or sprint boundary to start. * Pragmatic quality judgment. You can say "this risk is acceptable, ship it"as often as "this one isn't" * Sharp written communication. Your findings change what people do. **AI\-first working style** * Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent is already your primary development tool. * You use AI to accelerate the quality work itself (eval cases, graders, triage) and know where AI judgment ends and yours begins. * You review every AI\-generated diff. You do not merge on vibes. **Strongly preferred** * Stood up eval or observability infrastructure from zero, and it stuck. * LLM observability tooling: LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize, or homegrown. * Defined what an agent may do unsupervised and built the guardrails. * Worn a product hat: requirements, behavior, de facto PM for a surface. * Built deep domain expertise from scratch in a complex operational business. **Why this role** Most testing roles keep you at arm's length from the business and the product. This one doesn't. Every engineer here owns what they ship. You give the whole team the tools, testing, and domain insight to move fast and get it right. Eval infrastructure, hands\-on testing, real relationships with the business, and sometimes the product call itself: if you want that range with real production stakes and no bureaucracy in the way, this is that role. **Perks \& Benefits** * Curative Health Plan (100% employer\-covered medical premiums for you and 50% coverage for dependents on the base plan.) + $0 copays and $0 deductibles (with completion of our Baseline Visit ) + Preventive and primary care built in + Mental health support + One\-on\-one care navigation + Chronic condition programs (diabetes, weight, hypertension) + Maternity and family planning support + 24/7/365 Curative Telehealth + Pharmacy benefits * Comprehensive dental and vision coverage * Employer\-provided life and disability coverage with additional supplemental options * Flexible spending accounts * Generous PTO policy plus 11 paid annual company holidays * 401K for full\-time employees * Generous Up to 8–12 weeks paid parental leave, based on role eligibility.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Salesforce & Agentforce)
jobs.description: Overview: **Our Culture and Impact** Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. jobs.description: **R\&D Software Engineer** **About PDCflow** PDCflow is a proven leader in payment management and digital workflow software. Collecting payments, securing e\-signatures, and delivering invoices are the lifelines of business operation, but managing them separately can be tedious and time\-consuming. Our comprehensive platform combines secure payments and document workflows into one frictionless experience, leveraging decades of compliance expertise to streamline operations for our customers. **Role Overview** We are looking for a Software Engineer (R\&D Focused) to play a key role in building PDCflow’s next\-generation payment and transaction platform. First and foremost, you will be a hands\-on backend software engineer helping design, write, and deliver core features for our newest product. Beyond day\-to\-day product development, you will bring an exploratory R\&D mindset to the team: researching emerging technologies, building rapid proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and identifying better ways to modernize our stack. Your main day\-to\-day work will be backend\-heavy (Java, Spring, PostgreSQL, Docker), building secure, high\-throughput engines for our new product line. Side\-by\-side with feature delivery, you will explore new tools (such as Claude Code and AI\-assisted dev workflows) and test lightweight frameworks (like Svelte) to continually optimize how our engineering organization builds, containerizes, and deploys secure financial technology. **What You’ll Do** * **New Product Development:** Design, build, and deploy production\-ready RESTful APIs and backend microservices for PDCflow’s newest platform features using Java and Spring Boot. * **Database \& Data Architecture:** Write efficient SQL, design relational schemas, and optimize database performance in PostgreSQL to handle high\-volume transaction processing. * **Containerization \& Operations:** Package, run, and optimize containerized services using Docker across local and deployment environments. * **Targeted R\&D \& Prototyping:** Research, benchmark, and build targeted POCs for emerging tools and architectural patterns before bringing viable solutions into our core codebase. * **AI Tool Integration:** Experiment with and incorporate AI\-assisted developer workflows (**Claude Code**, LLM coding agents) to accelerate refactoring, testing, documentation, and feature delivery. **What We’re Looking For** **Core Technical Skills** * **5\+ years** of hands\-on software development experience with a strong foundation in backend engineering. * **Java \& Spring Framework:** Solid proficiency in Core Java and Spring Boot for building robust backend services and REST APIs. * **Database Fundamentals:** Strong SQL skills with **PostgreSQL**—ability to analyze, design, and optimize data models during POC development. * **Containerization:** Experience using **Docker** for local development setups, containerizing applications, and environment configuration. * **Exploratory Mindset:** A track record of testing new libraries, tools, and developer utilities on your own initiative. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Bonus Skills** * Active experience or curiosity in AI\-assisted development tools (**Claude Code**, GitHub Copilot, or CLI LLM integrations). * Familiarity with lightweight web frameworks like **Svelte** for rapid front\-end prototyping. * Exposure to fintech, payment processing, or compliance environments (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA). * Familiarity with microservices architecture, messaging queues, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Flexible Hybrid Model:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with a balanced hybrid schedule at our Ogden, UT office—alternating between 2 days in\-office one week and 1 day in\-office the next (just 6 days in\-office per month). * **High Autonomy \& Freedom:** You get dedicated time and space to investigate new tech without being locked into rigid, repetitive ticket\-slog sprints. * **Direct Team Impact:** Your research and POCs will directly influence the tech stack, tooling, and day\-to\-day productivity of the entire PDCflow engineering team. * **Modern Developer Culture:** We actively embrace cutting\-edge AI utilities like Claude Code to automate boilerplate work and focus on solving real engineering problems. * **Competitive Benefits:** Comprehensive Health, Vision, Dental, 401(k) match, generous PTO, and team perks.

jobs.title: IT Service Manager
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** -------------------- Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises, sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As an IT \& Business Systems Manager, you'll independently own IT and Business Systems for DataGrail, including endpoints, applications, and day\-to\-day operations for our team — operating with significant autonomy and shaping how the function runs, Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you'll be the face of technology for DataGrail's employees, the first call when something breaks, and the person building the automated, self\-service systems that let the company scale without scaling manual support. You'll partner closely with Security to build the controls DataGrail needs for ISO compliance, with real ownership over how this function evolves — and you'll extend the security engineering function's execution capacity, partnering hands\-on across day\-to\-day security workstreams rather than simply implementing controls handed down from Security. This is a chance to take a function in transition and build it into something modern: moving IT from reactive support to an automated, self\-service operation, partnering directly with Security on ISO compliance, and growing the scope of the role as DataGrail scales. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own IT and business systems operations for DataGrail's remote workforce, including endpoint management, identity, and the SaaS application footprint — provisioning and deprovisioning employee access across every tool, with an accurate inventory of renewals reviewed monthly. * Deliver hands\-on technical support across the company, resolving issues at the desktop level and setting the standard for fast, first\-call resolution. * Run onboarding and offboarding for the device and account lifecycle, delivering a smooth new\-hire IT experience and a clean exit when people leave. * Partner with Security to build and maintain the access controls, endpoint policies, and audit trails required for ISO compliance. * Partner hands\-on with DataGrail's security engineer, executing across day\-to\-day security workstreams such as tooling rollouts, and access reviews. * Build automation and self\-service tooling that reduces manual ticket volume while preserving strong controls and visibility. * Administer DataGrail's Apple\-based fleet end to end, from MDM policy to OS upgrades to hardware lifecycle. * Manage vendor relationships and DataGrail's SaaS vendor management process — onboarding and offboarding vendors and maintaining accurate records ensuring technology spend goes toward the right long\-term solutions. * Partner proactively across functions — surfacing IT needs, aligning on priorities, and serving as a reliable, go\-to point of contact for teams that depend on IT — building the systems and automation that make it easy for cross\-functional partners to self\-serve **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Proven, senior\-level experience independently owning a distributed, remote\-first IT environment at a company DataGrail's size — spanning endpoints, identity, and business applications, with full accountability for the function rather than execution against someone else's roadmap. * A track record of operating with high autonomy — setting direction for the function, making judgment calls independently, and being trusted with minimal day\-to\-day oversight. * Hands\-on experience administering MDM platforms (e.g., Kandji, Jamf, Hexnode) and Apple hardware and OS in an enterprise setting. * Strong understanding of identity and access management tools like Okta, and how they intersect with security and compliance requirements. * Experience building or maturing security and compliance controls, such as endpoint compliance or access reviews, ideally in support of a framework like ISO 27001\. * Comfort executing on security initiatives you didn't design, including vulnerability remediation, tooling rollouts, access reviews — working effectively in support of another owner's strategy. * A track record of automating manual IT workflows through scripting or self\-service tooling to reduce ticket volume and improve consistency. * Scripting experience in Python, and working with Claude Code and other AI tooling for building automation and self\-service tools and supporting Security functions as needed. . * Experience managing IT vendor relationships and technology spend against a formal vendor management process. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues for non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Bonus Points** * ISO 27001 (or similar framework) certification, or direct experience supporting an ISO audit. * Prior IT experience in a regulated industry or another SaaS company handling sensitive data. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **Within 90 Days You'll:** * Learn DataGrail's systems, tools, and team, and take ownership of IT helpdesk coverage so employees have reliable, first\-call support again. ### **Within 180 Days You'll:** * Independently own endpoint and access management, with foundational ISO\-relevant controls in place, early automation and self\-service initiatives underway, and functioning as an active hands\-on execution partner to the security engineer. ### **Within 365 Days You'll:** * Have positioned DataGrail for ISO audit readiness, with self\-service systems in place that reduce manual ticket handling while strengthening the company's control and audit posture. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500\+ integrations and no\-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a hands\-on Forward\-Deployed Product Engineer to help maintain, support, and extend a portfolio of production software products. This is a coding role first — but it is a coding role for someone who wants to sit close to the business, talk directly to the people using the software, and own outcomes rather than tickets. You will work across the full software development lifecycle: scoping problems with stakeholders, designing the approach, writing the code, testing it, shipping it, and supporting it in production. Our stack centers on Angular and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform behind it, plus PostgreSQL where relational data is the right fit. Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow. The ideal candidate is a practical software generalist with strong Angular fundamentals, genuine communication skills, and curiosity about why a feature is being requested in the first place. You will not only write code — you will help improve how our products are maintained, supported, tested, documented, and enhanced over time. **IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?** ========================= You will work across several products and industries in a given quarter, and you will talk to the people who use what you build. If you want to go three years deep on a single product with a product manager between you and the customer, this is not that role. If you like variety, ownership, and direct contact with the business, it is a very good one. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= **Engineering and Delivery** ---------------------------- * Own features end\-to\-end across multiple projects — from scoping conversations through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support. * Maintain and evolve Angular front ends, including component and service architecture, RxJS, routing, state management, dependency updates, UI improvements, and cross\-browser compatibility. * Build and modify backend logic and services using Node.js and TypeScript, including Firebase Cloud Functions, scheduled jobs, and third\-party integrations. * Work confidently in inherited codebases you did not write, including applications of different vintages, conventions, and framework versions. * Perform safe refactoring, code cleanup, and modernization without creating unnecessary disruption for users. * Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and release validation practices appropriate to the risk of each change. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools as a daily part of the workflow — reviewing, steering, and validating generated output rather than shipping it unexamined. **Platform, Data, and Cloud** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain Firebase and Google Cloud Platform backends, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, and related services. * Design data models across both NoSQL (Firestore) and relational (PostgreSQL) stores, and exercise judgment about when each is the right tool. * Write and tune SQL queries, manage schema changes, and support reporting and data extract needs. * Implement and maintain Firestore security rules, authentication flows, and role\-based permissions. * Manage cloud resources with attention to uptime, security, performance, and cost efficiency. * Maintain version control discipline, deployment readiness, and CI/CD workflows. **Business Partnership and Product Ownership** ---------------------------------------------- * Sit in directly with business stakeholders and end users to translate vague or evolving problems into concrete technical requirements — then build the solution. * Ask why a feature is being requested, and push back constructively when there is a simpler, cheaper, or more durable approach. * Translate business needs into clear technical tasks, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans. * Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, prioritization, and roadmap conversations rather than waiting for fully specified tickets. * Develop working familiarity with the business context of each product — the industry, the workflow, and what it costs the customer when the software is wrong. * Communicate status, risk, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences in writing and in person. **Support, Release, and Documentation** --------------------------------------- * Serve as the technical owner for escalated support issues, determining whether an issue is user error, configuration, defect, data problem, or a feature request. * Investigate production issues, identify root causes, implement fixes, and put safeguards in place to prevent recurrence. * Own or support the release process, including deployment coordination, testing, release notes, and post\-launch follow\-up. * Maintain current technical documentation covering application architecture, integrations, code changes, troubleshooting steps, and release history. * Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Requirements: * 3\+ years of relevant software development, SaaS engineering, application support, or product engineering experience preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred, but equivalent hands\-on experience is fully acceptable. * Strong Angular fundamentals — components, services, RxJS, routing, and state management — deep enough to transfer across projects with different conventions and framework versions. * Solid TypeScript and JavaScript skills; comfortable working in a typed codebase and committed to keeping it that way. * Working Node.js experience for backend services, Cloud Functions, scripting, and integrations. * Hands\-on experience with Firebase and Google Cloud Platform, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, and Hosting. * SQL fluency, ideally with PostgreSQL, including query writing, joins, and basic performance awareness. * Experience with Git, CI/CD concepts, deployment workflows, testing practices, bug tracking, and production troubleshooting. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor while maintaining human review and quality control. * Genuinely strong written and verbal communication — able to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical stakeholder and write a status update that does not generate follow\-up questions. * Comfort with ambiguity and frequent context\-switching across clients in different industries. * Self\-directed working style with light supervision — able to unblock yourself, and willing to escalate early when you cannot. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to support needs, and maintain professionalism under pressure. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Prior consulting, agency, forward\-deployed engineering, or other client\-facing delivery experience. * Experience supporting an established SaaS product, legacy application, government software, legal or court software, or a regulated workflow platform. * Experience with public sector, records, filing, case management, document management, or workflow software. * Experience supporting or modernizing older Angular versions and migrating them forward. * Experience with APIs, authentication, permissions models, reporting tools, and system integrations. * Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or Cloud Build. * Experience with Jira, Zoho, Notion, Trello, GitHub Issues, or similar project and ticket tracking systems. * A track record of improving testing, documentation, deployment reliability, or developer productivity on a team. **CORE COMPETENCIES** ===================== End\-to\-End Ownership Angular Craftsmanship Cloud and Data Judgment Stakeholder Communication Business Curiosity Problem Solving Product Judgment AI\-Assisted Development Documentation Accountability Customer Service Mindset Continuous Improvement

disruptions Lead, develop, and grow the team; set clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability; build team operating cadences, on\-call rotations, and capacity planning * **Required Qualifications** * 9\+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant time in platform engineering, infrastructure, IT service management, or IT operations * 3\+ years of direct team leadership experience, including building management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable team delivery * Demonstrated experience setting and driving the operational agenda for a function and contributing operational perspective to enterprise or cross\-functional strategy decisions, with specific examples of identifying what needed attention and what was brought to the table * Demonstrated experience holding operational standards through attrition, competing priorities, or pressure to deprioritize, with specific examples * Demonstrated experience 21 CFR Part 11, and SOX ITGC requirements * Hands\-on experience operating ITIL\-aligned service management (incident, change, problem, service level) * Experience operating enterprise network, virtualization, multi\-cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), backup and restore, observability tooling, and enterprise AI infrastructure or comparable shared platform services Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief senior leaders concisely with considered recommendations * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a commercial\-stage biotech or pharmaceutical company jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dentsu is operationalizing AI at scale. Across every brand and practice, business teams are identifying AI\-powered tools, platforms, and vendors they want to deploy — and they need a fast, expert path through the governance process to do it safely. The AI Governance Concierge Service is dentsu's answer to that challenge — a dedicated, end\-to\-end service that gives any Americas business team a single expert point of contact for AI product adoption. The AI Governance Engineer is the process navigator, program manager, and technical implementer of the service. Working in close coordination with the AI Governance Service Lead, the Governance Engineer receives each submission package approved by the Lead, thoroughly understands its contents — the business case, the vendor research, the risk profile, and the policy alignment — and takes full ownership of driving it through the cross\-functional review process. The Engineer is expected to speak to the details of every submission they manage, serve as the knowledgeable point of contact for all reviewing functions, coordinate with the Analyst when additional research or documentation is needed, and own the end\-to\-end implementation once approval is granted. This role ensures nothing stalls, nothing is lost, and every engagement crosses the finish line. The AI Governance Concierge Service is not simply an approval function — it is a service built around bringing every engagement to a successful conclusion. That means approving solutions that meet dentsu's standards, identifying alternative products or approaches that address the business need within governance requirements, and providing solutions that facilitate approval where possible. When risks are identified that prevent approval, the service's role is to clearly document and communicate those risks and leave the decision to the business to weigh the risk and reward. Success is a business team that always has a clear path forward — not just a ruling. **What You Will Do** **Submission Intake \& Program Management** * Receive and thoroughly review each submission package approved by the Service Lead — developing a deep understanding of the business case, vendor research, risk profile, and policy rationale before the review process begins. * Project\-manage each submission through the full review lifecycle in AIRS and TPSA — tracking every open item, deadline, and reviewer action from submission to final determination. * Set and communicate the review schedule for each submission based on priorities identified and communicated by the Lead; maintain that schedule actively throughout the review and implementation phases. * Update the AI Concierge Program Tracker with accurate, real\-time progress during the review and implementation phases, ensuring the Service Lead always has a current view across all active engagements. * Work closely with the Analyst when reviewers require additional research, documentation, or clarification — coordinating the request clearly, reviewing what comes back for completeness, and routing it to the appropriate reviewing function without delay. * Report status, progress, and blockers to the Service Lead on a regular cadence, enabling the Lead to keep the business team accurately informed at all times. **Cross\-Functional Review \& Relationships** * Build and maintain trusted working relationships with counterparts in Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, and Procurement — positioning the Concierge Service as an organized, reliable partner that makes their review process easier, not harder. * Shepherd each submission through the full cross\-functional review process — serving as the knowledgeable, primary point of contact for all reviewing functions, engaging each group with the context and detail they need to review confidently. * Partner with Global Enterprise Technology to shepherd each request through the review process, ensure Global Enterprise Technology's requirements are met at the engagement level, and coordinate the technical backend of implementation. * Translate technical and legal concerns from reviewers back to the Service Lead and Analyst in plain language — enabling accurate communication to the business team and ensuring the Analyst has what they need to produce any required follow\-up documentation. **Escalation \& Risk Management** * Identify blockers within the governance or review process and surface them to the Service Lead immediately with clear context and recommended resolution paths. * Own the follow\-through on blockers — actively working to resolve open items, maintaining momentum on stalled submissions, and not waiting for issues to resolve themselves. * Escalate risk\-flagged items to the Service Lead and relevant stakeholders; document disposition rationale for all escalated items. **Implementation \& Delivery** * Upon approval, own and coordinate the full implementation of each approved solution — working w n, and clear communication. * Clear, precise communicator — able to translate between technical, legal, and business audiences without losing accuracy in either direction. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media, marketing, advertising, or professional services organization. * Familiarity with GenAI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\) or data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). * Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and their enterprise deployment requirements. * Background in vendor risk assessment, third\-party due diligence, or enterprise technology procurement. * Experience with Coupa, ServiceNow, OneTrust, or similar enterprise workflow and compliance platforms. * IAPP AIGP, CIPP, CISSP, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** In your first 90 days, you have taken ownership of the active submission queue, established working relationships with your counterparts in Legal, Privacy, Security, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology, and can speak confidently to the details of every submission in your queue. You have a clear, documented view of where every open engagement stands and what is needed to move each one forward. At six months, the average time\-to\-approval has measurably decreased. No submission goes dark — every open item has an owner, a deadline, and a next action. Reviewing functions know who you are and trust that you come prepared. You have completed at least one end\-to\-end implementation, and the Analyst rarely needs to be pulled back into a submission once it has entered your review queue. At one year, the Governance Engineer function is recognized across the review community as a reliable, organized partner. The implementation pipeline is clean, the CSDM is accurate, and the post\-launch review process is a standard part of every engagement. Your process improvements have meaningfully reduced the manual effort required to move a submission from intake to closure. The annual salary range for this position is $82,500 \- $130,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance, * Life insurance, * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, * 401k, * Flexible paid time off, * At least 15 paid holidays per year, * Paid sick and safe leave, and * Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies.
