Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report. **Job Description** We are seeking a Software Developer to join the InteleShare team and contribute to Intelerad's secure, cloud\-based medical image sharing platform. In this role, you will design and deliver features that connect healthcare providers, imaging centers, hospitals, and patients — enabling timely, accurate diagnoses across institutions and geographies. You will work within a cross\-functional Agile team, take ownership of features end to end, and contribute to a platform that handles DICOM medical imaging at scale. InteleShare is a polyglot platform: a Perl/mod\_perl services tier on PostgreSQL, a JavaScript web client (jQuery and vanilla JavaScript across the established pages, React and TypeScript in newer areas), a Java (Spring Boot) storage service backed by S3 and other cloud object stores, and a C\#/.NET on\-premises harvester that speaks DICOM and HL7 to customer PACS. You will start in one or two of these codebases and grow into the others over time. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain features across the InteleShare web application and services tier — typically the web front end (jQuery and vanilla JavaScript in the established pages, React in newer areas) and the Perl service APIs it calls — taking ownership from scoping through delivery, ensuring solutions are tested, documented, and meet sprint commitments. * Write and tune PostgreSQL queries and schema changes for a large, high\-volume production database, following the team's schema versioning and migration process. * Translate customer support escalations and stakeholder requirements into well\-engineered technical solutions, reproducing issues across the full stack (browser, API, database, storage, DICOM/HL7 interfaces) and resolving root causes rather than symptoms. * Contribute to code quality through thorough pull request reviews, unit and integration tests, and clear documentation, supporting team\-wide standards and knowledge sharing. * Support DevOps and operational initiatives including containerized AWS/Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and participation in production troubleshooting alongside senior engineers. * Work as a full\-stack generalist across languages and codebases as business needs evolve, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking the initiative to implement them within an Agile/Scrum workflow. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * 3\+ years of professional web application development experience, or equivalent experience with a demonstrable track record of delivering production\-quality software. * Proficiency in at least one server\-side language (Perl, Python, Java, C\#, Ruby, PHP, or equivalent) and willingness to become productive in Perl, which powers the InteleShare services tier. * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including the ability to read query plans and diagnose slow queries. * Solid JavaScript skills, including direct DOM and jQuery work; experience with React or a comparable component framework. * Proven ability to work independently in a distributed team environment, managing priorities and delivering outcomes with minimal oversight. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex, long\-term goals into well\-scoped, deliverable increments. * Comfort working across multiple languages, frameworks, and problem domains as business needs evolve. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Perl development experience (mod\_perl or other server\-side Perl). * REST API and PostgreSQL database development expertise. * Frontend development experience: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS/LESS, and React (with Redux, TypeScript, and a component library such as Ant Design in newer areas); familiarity with webpack, Jest, and Playwright or Selenium. * Familiarity with containerized deployment: building Docker images and working with Helm charts in a Kubernetes pod deployment model. * Git/GitHub version control experience and familiarity with unit and integration testing best practices. * AWS cloud services knowledge (S3, EC2, RDS, ECR, CloudWatch). * Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology in fast\-paced development environments. * Background in healthcare technology: DICOM, HL7, FHIR, medical imaging, or radiology workflow understanding. * Exposure to a regulated development environment (HIPAA, FDA, ISO 13485/9001, or similar). *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** The base pay for this position ranges from $86,250/yr \- $115,000/yr USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application. \#LI\-REMOTE Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Factory Orchestration
jobs.description: Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. **Role** -------- The Intrinsic Factory Experience is an integrated human interface to define, manage, and monitor highly orchestrated factory operations. We build tools to help forward\-thinking factories deploy intelligent, flexible manufacturing workflows at scale. Our tools help manufacturing process designers to optimize their resources, factory managers to make sense of their operations, and floor workers to strategically direct their attention. We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic Factory Orchestration team. In this role, you will be responsible for not only developing human\-machine user interfaces (HMI), but also optimizing the performance and functionality of client\-side rendering, server\-side databases, and integration with other backend APIs in Intrinsic. You will develop the full stack of web interfaces for end\-to\-end factory orchestration tasks and play a vital role in the development of our frontend libraries and components, ensuring a cohesive and user\-friendly experience for all customers. The interfaces you build will shape our product and the role of the human in it. You are excited by the prospect of owning critical pieces of our user experience (including collaborating with the Product and Design teams, and developing tests). You have excellent development skills across the web application stack and are excited to be part of a world\-class, innovative, frontend team. **How your work moves the mission forward** ------------------------------------------- * Develop intuitive and innovative interfaces in collaboration with Product, Design, and Engineering teams. * Own the full stack of the Intrinsic Factory Experience web application, from database design to user interactions. * Build and maintain the backend logic and infrastructure of the frontend, including server\-side functionality and client\-side state management. * Monitor and improve the health (performance, robustness) of the Intrinsic Factory Experience. **Skills you will need to be successful** ----------------------------------------- * At least 3 years of experience with frontend web engineering, including proficiency in building client\-side (TypeScript/Javascript) software. * Extensive experience in building the full\-stack, including server\-side (Rust, Go, Python, etc.) software. * Experience with building visually\-rich web applications that enable deep user interactions. * Familiar with integrating databases, user\-access control, and basic authentication/authorization into web apps. * Ability to work with Rust, both for backends and compiled to web assembly for front ends. **Skills that will differentiate your candidacy** ------------------------------------------------- * Experience integrating web apps with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). * Ability to design scalable web apps. * Understanding of interface cohesion across a variety of network bandwidths, multiple screen sizes, and differing client\-side hardware. * Experience building dashboards aimed at various user personas. * Experience with creating and maintaining an intuitive, high quality, accessible system of reusable frontend components in collaboration with Design and Product teams. *The base salary for this full\-time position is between $147,200 \- $200,900* *(USD**) \+ 15%* *bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.* At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: candidate\-support@intrinsic.ai.

jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Become a part of Intuit's Enterprise Accountant Suite community as a Senior Staff Software Engineer and contribute to our mission of powering global prosperity. Our Builder Catalysts are distinguished by their extreme ownership and co\-creation with cross\-functional partners throughout the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and customer research to rapid experimentation and final execution. We are dedicated to building AI\-native experiences from the ground up, utilizing artificial intelligence to resolve the most intricate challenges facing our customers. We seek engineers who are customer\-obsessed, excel in boundaryless collaboration, and prioritize the delivery of transformative AI solutions. Come join Intuit as part of the Fintech \- Payments team as a Senior Staff Software Engineer to build world class Payments \& Invoicing capabilities across our customer segments. **Responsibilities** * Drives velocity in the organization by accelerating customer, business, and technology outcomes by identifying and driving key opportunities across the company * Hands\-on technologist who actively contributes to code, architecture decisions, and drives significant technology initiatives end\-to\-end * Understands customer behaviors and partners with cross\-functional partners to influence and drive end\-to\-end solutions for customer problems * Drives design and implementation of durable software solutions that solve critical customer problems in a fast\-paced environment * Executes with a boundaryless mindset and contributes to solutions outside of their primary area of ownership * Knowledge of building AI native applications * Prior working experience in teams that have built AI native applications for 1\+ years * Guides the applicability of AI to customer problems through a deep understanding of the value and limitations of AI technologies * Understands evaluation tools to validate and measure the accuracy of solutions * High\-level understanding of how AI models work, the different types of AI models that exist, and their pros and cons * Understanding of the latest tools and technologies that apply AI to real\-world applications * Creates robust, scalable, and secure technical designs, effectively implementing them to balance short\-term and long\-term objectives, ensuring high availability and optimal performance of applications * Passionate for continuous learning, experimenting, and applying cutting\-edge technology and software paradigms to solve customer problems **Qualifications** Ability to drive velocity in a highly matrixed environment, partnering with numerous stakeholders. * 10\+ years of experience developing systems/software for large business environments. * 7\+ years of experience designing complex distributed systems, management products, or business applications. * Full\-stack development experience with AI technologies/tools and apply it to user experiences or backend solutions. * Experience with AI technologies like SageMaker, Vert.x, LangChain, Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, DialogFlow, Python * Experience with React, Typescript, NodeJS, Java, Spring * Prior working experience in a cloud computing environment like AWS/GCP is highly desired. * Prior experience working in teams that have built AI native applications for 1\+ years BS/MS in Computer Science or related area. * Explicit experience with coding using Code Assist tools like Claude, including the development of custom plugins or applications Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $220,500 \- $298,500

jobs.title: Human Factors Design Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Human Factors * REF24873M ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of the Position** As part of the Intuitive Human Factors team, the Senior Human Factors Engineer works closely with designers, clinical engineers, system and software engineers, technical product managers, regulatory affairs, and other important functional teams. The Senior Human Factors Engineer is a key contributor in informing and guiding development of new products, and ensuring that those products are feasible, viable and desirable. The Human Factors Design Engineer will serve as the Human Factors (HF) Lead on new and/or sustaining product development teams within Intuitive. Within the project team, the Human Factors Design Engineer (HFDE), works closely with designers, clinical engineers, system and software engineers, product managers, regulatory affairs, and other cross functional teams. They have primary responsibility to conduct research to gain a deep understanding of users, uses and use environments; perform task analysis, analyze and characterize usability considerations and use\-related risks; conduct iterative formative evaluations with end\-users to realize the impact of design concepts on user workflow, behavior and performance; translate user needs into usability requirements to inform design; and be accountable for final usability validation. The Human Factors Design Engineer also works closely with the regulatory, quality and design controls teams to define the submission strategy from HF perspective and be accountable for the usability engineering documentation required for submission to medical device regulatory agencies. The Human Factors Design Engineer position reports to a Manager within the broader Human Factors (HF) organization at Intuitive. **Essential Job Duties** **Research:** * Plan, collect and synthesize data to generate insights on how and why users interact with Intuitive products through various techniques including interviews, simulations, direct observations, workflow labs, human performance research, persona development, usability testing, mixed methods research, discovery from known use problems, etc. * Represent Intuitive during interactions with end\-user clinicians and customers in multiple international markets to gather design insights in a highly professional manner, during formative research activities. * De\-risk design strategies by identifying root causes and conduct root cause analyses that account for human performance influencers underlying the user experience **Design:** * Analyze, define and evaluate workflow and user interface designs. Negotiate design recommendations and improvements to prevent hazardous situations related to use errors and improve usability. * Accountable for establishment, authoring and management of usability design inputs. Translate findings from formative research activities into insights that are used to define evidence\- based user requirements and user interface design requirements to inform user interface design, labeling and training. * Develop conceptual prototypes that reflect performance influencers for showcasing and translating for stakeholders * Advocate strongly and consistently for the clinical caregiver experience for safety and usability, with understanding of the nuance and balance of user/customer needs and business needs. **Test**: * Design, execute, and report on usability evaluations at various stages of product development, from explorative co\-creation of design with end users, to formal usability studies to evaluate usability and risk with prototypes of varying degrees of fidelity. * As HF Lead on projects, accountable for summative usability validation and design validation of usability design inputs. Collaborate closely with internal human factors partners to define and execute validations. **Analyze**: * Write and revise highly accurate, clear, and concise usability engineering document nications. * Ability to work with and across various groups and levels of management within the organization, including other engineering groups, marketing, clinical engineering, and regulatory. * Ability to apply user\-centered design and usability engineering principles to product research, development, and design. * Ability to travel internationally, as well as domestically (up to 25%). **Required Education and Training** * Minimum BS or MS in Human Factors Engineering, Cognitive Psychology, Biomedical Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction, Human\-Centered Design, or a related field, with emphasis in Interaction Design and User Interface Design. **Working Conditions** * Ability to travel internationally as well as domestically (up to 25%). * Primarily office\-based set schedule working model **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Experience in medical device, or similar regulated industry. * Experience with design engineering in product development. * Ability to empathize with people and to understand the human condition. * Ability to interface with customers in a highly professional manner. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills. We provide market\-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position:** We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Specialist to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it. Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. jobs.title: Principal, AI Security
jobs.description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron, Inc. (NASDAQ: ITRI) is a global leader in technology and services dedicated to the resourceful use of energy and water. With more than 300 million connected endpoints deployed worldwide, Itron is one of the world's largest and most successful IoT companies. Through innovative technology, software, and services, we help utilities and cities improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and build a more resourceful and sustainable future. As we accelerate adoption of artificial intelligence across our enterprise, products, and services, we are seeking an exceptional security leader to help shape and secure the future of AI at Itron.**Role Summary** The Principal, AI Security Architecture \& Engineering serves as Itron's senior technical authority for AI security. This highly visible, hands\-on leadership role is responsible for defining and implementing the security architecture, governance controls, engineering standards, and operational practices that enable safe, scalable adoption of artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, and AI agents across the enterprise and product portfolio. The ideal candidate combines deep cybersecurity expertise with practical experience securing modern AI ecosystems, including autonomous and semi\-autonomous agents, large language models, AI platforms, model gateways, non\-human identities, and data access controls. This individual will partner closely with Information Security, Product Security, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and business leaders to help drive innovative AI capabilities while protecting customers, products, data, and intellectual property.**Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Define and lead Itron's enterprise AI security strategy, architecture, policies, standards, reference architectures, and multi\-year roadmap. * Design and implement security controls across the AI and agent lifecycle, including registration, inventory management, identity governance, credential protection, authorization boundaries, autonomy controls, human oversight checkpoints, memory isolation, and agent decommissioning. * Establish scalable security guardrails for generative AI platforms, model integrations, APIs, plugins, automation workflows, AI assistants, and emerging agentic ecosystems. * Develop and maintain governance controls supporting privacy, confidentiality, data protection, transparency, explainability, accountability, ethical AI use, and bias mitigation. * Lead AI\-focused threat modeling, adversarial testing, security reviews, and risk assessments for enterprise and customer\-facing solutions. * Evaluate and mitigate emerging AI threats, including prompt injection, tool misuse, privilege escalation, AI supply chain compromise, context poisoning, insecure agent interactions, and rogue agent behavior. * Partner with engineering, product, and architecture teams to embed secure\-by\-design principles into the development, deployment, testing, and operation of AI\-enabled systems. * Advance the use of AI within Cybersecurity by designing and piloting AI\-assisted capabilities that improve detection engineering, threat hunting, vulnerability management, alert triage, evidence collection, and operational effectiveness. * Define security logging, telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and reporting requirements that measure AI control effectiveness and detect anomalous or malicious activity. * Develop and operate AI Security Posture Management capabilities, including inventories, risk assessments, third\-party evaluations, incident response processes, compliance readiness, and ongoing monitoring. * Conduct security assessments of AI vendors, platforms, and service providers with emphasis on architecture, data handling, privacy, access controls, resiliency, and operational risk. * Provide technical leadership and guidance for AI\-related incidents, investigations, governance decisions, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance reviews. * Author clear technical standards, reference architectures, implementation guidance, and executive communications that enable responsible and secure AI adoption. * Mentor engineers, architects, and security practitioners while fostering a collaborative, customer\-centric culture that balances innovation with risk management. * Stay current on evolving AI technologies, industry regulations, attack techniques, and emerging security best practices, translating insights into actionable improvements for Itron. **Required Skills \& Experience** --------------------------------- * 7\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, identity and access management, application security, product security, or a related technical discipline.  a protection, logging, monitoring, and third\-party integrations. * Proven experience conducting threat modeling, architecture reviews, security assessments, control validations, and cyber risk evaluations. * Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, secure software design principles, and modern security architectures. * Ability to analyze complex AI and cybersecurity risks and communicate practical recommendations to both technical and business leaders. * Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across diverse teams while driving accountability, collaboration, and execution in a fast\-changing technology environment. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Preferred Skills \& Experience** ---------------------------------- * Experience securing large\-scale deployments of frontier AI models through direct provider APIs, Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, model gateways, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, AI gateway technologies, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Vertex AI, Databricks AI capabilities, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, MITRE ATLAS, ISO/IEC 42001, and AI regulatory readiness initiatives. * Experience performing AI red teaming, adversarial testing, prompt injection testing, abuse\-case development, or AI deployment readiness assessments. * Background in secure software development, DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, software supply chain security, or product security architecture reviews. * Experience operating in regulated industries or environments aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, CMMC, critical infrastructure, utilities, or similar compliance frameworks. * Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, Microsoft Security certifications, cloud security certifications, AI governance certifications, AI security certifications, or equivalent credentials. **Travel:** Less than 25% on average**Benefits Info:** This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more! The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience and may vary by location. The base salary is $96,000\-165,000 annually. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program. \#LI\-EP1 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. and operational runbooks **Forward\-Looking ML/AI Enablement** * Evaluate, pilot, and productionize Databricks\-native AI/ML capabilities — including Genie for natural\-language data access and MLflow for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, Feature Store, and Model Serving * Support the build\-out of vector search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns on top of governed Unity Catalog data for internal AI use cases * Collaborate with data science and analytics stakeholders to prepare curated, ML\-ready Gold\-layer datasets and feature pipelines * Stay current on the Databricks roadmap (Lakehouse AI, Mosaic AI, Agent frameworks) and recommend adoption where it advances platform maturity and business value * Help define guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop controls privacy standards across the platform **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, statistics, or related field or equivalent work experience * 7\+ years of experience as a data engineer with 3\+ years specifically architecting and operating production workloads on Databricks * Strong understanding of data governance, data security, and access control best practices * Experience with Agile development methodologies, CI/CD automation, and Test\-Driven Development * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to lead technical jobs.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Description: The Junior DevOps Engineer handles designing, creating, and supporting automation to help support the Software Development Life Cycle. They support the implementation of the Infrastructure as Code configuration and artifacts. They help set up and respond to alerts around critical systems. They collaborate closely with their cross functional teams to help identify and implement areas of improvement as well as support the release process. Finally, they work with Senior DevOps Engineers to find areas of improvement and growth. Additionally, due to the sensitive nature of the data, the Junior DevOps Engineer will have the opportunity to work with the rest of the business to create, support, and ensure compliance with the auditable controls necessary to properly secure our customers’ data. Essential duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Automation of company processes, such as daily ETL, software deployments, infrastructure monitoring and alerting, as examples * Automation of customer processes, such as packaging and transmission of report files * Designing and maintenance of operational infrastructure * Helping with adherence and auditing of security controls to support SOC 2 certification * Protecting customers data with continuous security practices and monitoring * Assisting internal teams with the research and resolution of customer support issues * Provisioning and onboarding of new customer tenants * Collaborating with cross functional teams to help deliver end\-to\-end KlariVis offers a competitive compensation package including salary, medical, dental, HSA health benefits, 401(k) match, and flexible time off. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, technical expertise, education, certifications, internal equity, and other job\-related qualifications. KlariVis is headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia.Applicants must be currently based and authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. KlariVis does NOT sponsor applicants for work visas. Requirements: Required * 0\-2 years of experience in an operational, IT, or software engineering role. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)
jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* **Staff Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)** =============================================== **About the Team:** ------------------- Our Engineering team builds the AI systems that power how brands run their businesses on Klaviyo. We move fast, ship in production, and hold a high bar for what "AI\-native" actually means: systems that make real judgment calls, not demos. The Customer Agent team is one of the newest and most ambitious groups in that org, based in Boston and working in\-office: we're building a conversational AI system that lets brands serve their own customers at a scale no human support team could match. We're still small enough that one engineer's work visibly shapes how the whole platform evolves. We're past the demo stage: the team ships changes against live customer traffic, measures quality with real evaluation frameworks, and treats reliability as a product feature, not an afterthought. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Engineer, you'll set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent end to end, building a 0\-to\-1 agentic product with the speed and ownership of a startup, backed by the scale and resources of one of the most innovative tech companies on the East Coast, while staying hands\-on with the hardest problems yourself. This is a lead\-level role, with a wide footprint across our agentic product \- from orchestration to governance \- that grows based on where the product is when you join. We're looking for an engineer who owns complex, ambiguous problems, who has built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system through everything that comes after the demo, and who up\-levels the people, process, and technology around them. **How You'll Make an Impact:** ------------------------------ * Set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent, from architecture through production, and contribute to the direction of the platform overall. * Take on the hardest technical problems in your area: orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, memory \& context, failure handling for non\-deterministic systems. * Write and ship code, review designs, and make the hard calls in your area when there's no obvious right answer. * Define patterns that other engineers adopt, and mentor through design reviews rather than direct management. * Partner with product, design, data science, and go\-to\-market leaders to shape what gets built, not just how it's built. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and bring the ones worth betting on into production. **What We're Looking For:** --------------------------- * You've built, scaled, and supported production agentic systems, not just prototyped them: real orchestration, evals, guardrails, and non\-deterministic failure handling. You've owned your part of one through launch, incidents, and the operational reality after the demo. * You've learned the hard lessons that only come from running agents in production: securing them against misuse and abuse, and the operational scar tissue of keeping a non\-deterministic system reliable as usage grows. * You've owned technical and product direction for a significant area before, not just your own component, and you can point to something you designed and championed that shipped and that other engineers built on. * You're hands\-on: writing code, reviewing your own and others' architecture decisions, and debugging production issues yourself, not delegating the hardest problems away. * Your patterns and designs are reused by other engineers, and you've unblocked many others' projects, not just your own. * You communicate complex technical trade\-offs clearly across engineering and product audiences, and you can turn an undefined problem into a plan others rally behind. **Nice to Haves:** ------------------ * Experience working on a multi\-tenant agent platform at production scale, where external customers configure their own agent behavior on shared infrastructure. * Experience building 0\-to\-1 products or working in startup environments. * A track record with production evaluation systems, AI observability, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows for LLM\-powered products. Boston, MA \- In\-Office Role *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, where you'll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you'll join us. *AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human\-in\-the\-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.* *By participating in Klaviyo's interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our* *Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process**. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our* *Job Applicant Privacy Notice**.* *Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non\-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non\-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.* **By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. If you do not wish for Klaviyo to process your Personal Data, please do not submit an application.***You can find our Job Applicant Privacy Notice* *here* *and* *here* *(FR).*

jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Lab3 is a third\-party logistics (3PL) provider offering direct\-to\-consumer and wholesale fulfillment services from our New Jersey facility. We are a small, hands\-on team, and we are investing in AI tools to improve how we manage customer service, billing, and warehouse operations. **Position Summary** The AI Implementation Specialist will design, build, and maintain AI\-powered tools and workflows that automate manual processes across the business. This is a hands\-on building role. Approximately 80% of the time will be spent developing solutions within AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude, and approximately 20% coordinating with team members to roll those solutions out. The position reports to the CTO/COO. Initial projects include: * **Customer service request management.** Build a human\-in\-the\-loop system that captures incoming requests from email, WhatsApp, and phone, routes them to the appropriate team member, tracks follow\-up, and confirms resolution. * **Billing.** Automate invoice generation, invoice auditing, and billing status tracking. * **Later phases.** Service\-level (SLA) tracking and warehouse operations processes. **Responsibilities** * Identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone processes and propose practical AI\-based solutions * Design, build, test, and maintain automations, agents, scheduled tasks, and workflows within AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, and similar tools) * Evaluate and integrate complementary automation tools (for example, Zapier or Make) where appropriate * Take ownership of assigned problems from initial discussion through delivery, including testing and iteration based on feedback * Document workflows and tools so that team members can use and maintain them * Communicate progress, options, and trade\-offs clearly to leadership and end users **Qualifications** * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building solutions with AI platforms such as ChatGPT or Claude, including agents, custom GPTs or projects, scheduled tasks, or automated workflows * Ability to take a loosely defined business problem and deliver a working solution with minimal supervision * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several projects at once * Clear written and verbal communication skills * An understanding of business processes and how to improve them * Comfort working with systems and data; programming experience is not required Early\-career candidates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. If you have built AI tools, agents, or automations on your own, including personal projects is a plus. **Compensation and Benefits** * Annual salary: $80,000 (full\-time, exempt) * Paid time off * Standard business hours; no travel required **Work Location and Schedule** This is a hybrid position. Our office is currently located in Ridgefield, NJ, and will be relocating to the Edison/Somerset area. The role is primarily on\-site, with one to two remote days per week. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of northern or central New Jersey. **Hiring Process** Apply using the link below. Selected candidates will have a short screening conversation, followed by two to three interviews with the team. The target start date is mid\-October 2026\. **How to Apply** Apply at: https://app.heedhire.com/apply/intk\_3a303547\-8685\-4f76\-89c6\-4ac5b288d142 **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lab3 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Pay: $80,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer, AI Observability & Evals Platform (LangSmith)
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production\-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open\-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M\+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000\+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (\+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. **About The Team** ================== The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end\-to\-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done. **About The Role** ================== *This role is based onsite in Boston, MA.* We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing engineering team in Boston. In this role you will be building the backend systems that power LangSmith, LangChain’s observability and evals platform. You will work on the core services that allow our customer's developer teams to monitor and evaluate their AI applications at scale. While the focus is on backend feature development, familiarity with fullstack or frontend engineering, performance tuning, and debugging production issues would be valuable. **What You'll Do:** =================== * Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs to support LangSmith’s tracing, monitoring, and evaluation workflows. * Collaborate on architectural decisions to ensure systems are performant and maintainable. * Optimize storage and query performance for high\-volume observability and evaluation data. * Ensure system reliability through strong testing, monitoring, and alerting practices. * Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performing root\-cause analysis and implementing long\-term fixes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, including system design and API references. * Work closely with full\-stack engineers, product managers, and product designers on rolling out new features. **What You'll Bring:** ====================== * 4\+ years of professional experience in backend engineering working on highly complex products * Proficiency in one or more backend languages/frameworks, ideally Python and/or Go * Strong understanding of API design and building reliable data services. * Experience with high\-throughput, mission\-critical systems. * Demonstrated ability to optimize backend services for performance and reliability. * Experience with database systems (Postgres, Redis, Clickhouse), and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) would be a bonus. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross\-functionally. * Customer centricity and ownership mentality **Compensation:** Annual salary range: $180,000\- $240,000 **Compensation Philosophy:** We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. **Benefits** ============ Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in\-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- LCI is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber AS400 Developer/Admin for a long\-term contract engagement. This critical resource will provide essential application maintenance, database management, and application\-level administration services for OID’s core IBM AS/400 (IBM i Series) environment. Because the underlying AS/400 hardware partition, operating system, and baseline infrastructure are fully hosted and managed by an external provider, this position does not require hardware or OS\-level systems engineering. Instead focus will be on application development, software support, database management, and serving as the technical liaison to Ensono for environment\-level modifications. Additionally, the contractor will play a key role in assisting state IT leadership with database extraction, documentation of legacy business logic, and support for ongoing cloud migration and data archiving initiatives. . **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Maintain, modify, and optimize custom legacy application code written in RPG, RPG III, RPG IV (ILE RPG), RPGLE, and Control Language (CL). * Investigate and troubleshoot operational bugs, batch run anomalies, and user\-reported system issues. * Update existing logic to adapt to regulatory changes, licensing requirements, and agency business process updates. * Serve as the primary technical point of contact to coordinate with the hosting provider for system maintenance, OS patching schedules, database utilities, and environmental adjustments. * Manage application\-level security configurations, including user profiles, object\-level authority, and verify system audit logs (QAUDJRN) to maintain system integrity. * Manage local job queues, active subsystems, and application\-level job schedulers. * Coordinate with Ensono’s storage and backup operations teams to ensure application backup windows, disaster recovery testing, and restoration verifications are carried out successfully. * Query, manage, and tune DB2 for i databases, optimizing SQL queries and indexes to ensure database responsiveness. * Support secure, automated file transfers (SFTP/FTP) and interfaces between the hosted AS400 partition and downstream state, regional, or partner systems. * Document system flows, database schemas, and interdependencies to facilitate a seamless transition of legacy business logic to modern cloud systems. * Maintain a working familiarity with legacy system architectures, dependencies, and integration points to safely support operational systems while building modern alternatives. Data Integrity, Reporting \& Integration Support * Develop and maintain application logic and API integrations that ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across HR and administrative systems. * Support reporting needs by building or optimizing system components that feed reporting tools such as Power BI or similar platforms. * Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and implement technical solutions to improve system performance and customer satisfaction. jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO / CMO) — Regenerative Medicine Clinic
jobs.description: ONE OF TWO PLACES ON EARTH There are two facilities in the world with the capability to treat patients with induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) — in clinical trials and in the clinic. RENUE Medical Centre is one of them. We are a regenerative medicine and longevity clinic on the Joya Hospital Group campus in Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico, serving patients from the United States and Canada who cannot access advanced cell therapies at home. Our medical team delivers allogenic MSC therapy, peptide and NAD\+ protocols, and — through our sister company Cellarion — autologous iPSC therapy, the frontier of the field. We are trusted by 23 golf tour professionals and legends of the game, who put their bodies and their careers in our hands. We treated 170 patients in 2025, our pricing sits alongside the top US longevity clinics, and we are backed by a growth round led by Longevity Venture Fund I. Getting the licenses, protocols, equipment and people in place took two years. Scaling it is the next job — and that is the job we are hiring for. THE ROLE We are hiring a hands\-on Chief Operating Officer to run the Nuevo Vallarta flagship end to end — both the operation and the growth. This is a combined COO / CMO seat: you will own everything between a stranger's first encounter with RENUE and a discharged, delighted, referring patient. On the operations side that means scheduling and patient flow, clinical operations support for the medical team, the Patient Advisor team, supply chain for cells and consumables, quality and compliance, facilities, staffing and the weekly numbers. On the growth side it means US and Canadian patient acquisition: paid media, SEO and content, channel partners, lifecycle and conversion. This is an operator's seat, not an executive\-suite seat. You will be on the floor with the clinical team, on calls with US patients and their families, in the ad accounts and the analytics, and in the spreadsheets every week. You will report directly to the Founder \& CEO and work alongside our Medical Director, our biotech engineer and our hospital partner. RENUE is a startup. The base salary is deliberately modest, and the equity is deliberately meaningful. We are looking for someone who wants to build — and own a piece of what they build — in a category that is being defined right now. WHY THIS SEAT IS DIFFERENT * You will run one of only two clinical operations in the world working with iPSCs, on a hospital campus, with the science and the patients in the same building. * The demand is real: a treated\-patient base, a roster of professional athletes as patients and ambassadors, and a growth round to fund the ramp to 50 treated patients per month. * The upside is real: equity tranches that vest as you deliver growth, in a company at the start of its curve. * The work is real: you will be measured on patients treated, cost to acquire them, margin and compliance — not on slide decks. WHAT YOU WILL OWN * Clinic operations: daily and weekly scheduling, treatment\-week logistics, room and staff utilization, patient flow from arrival to discharge, and the follow\-up cadence that drives outcomes, reviews and referrals. * Patient experience: concierge\-level coordination for international patients — travel, accommodation, hospital campus navigation, family communication — delivered in English and Spanish. * Patient Advisor team: recruiting, training (we have a written training manual), scripts, consult\-to\-booking conversion, CRM hygiene, and hand\-off from our AI Patient Advisor to live advisors. * Clinical operations support: working with the Medical Director and physicians on protocols, consent and documentation, adverse\-event reporting, and standard operating procedures across our MSC, peptide, NAD\+ and iPSC programs. * Cell and consumables supply chain: coordinating with our biotech engineer and with Cellarion on cell scheduling, cold chain, inventory, consumables, vendor management and cost control. * Quality, compliance and licensing: COFEPRIS and hospital\-campus requirements, records, audits, and the documentation that lets us say to a US patient, credibly, that this is a protocol\-driven clinic. * People: hiring, onboarding, schedules, performance management and culture for clinical, advisor and administrative staff; payroll and HR administration in Mexico with our accountants. * Finance operations: weekly and monthly reporting against the scaling model — treated patients, revenue per patient, contribution margin, cash — plus invoicing, collections, purchasing and expense control. * Cellarion interface: operational and marketing coordination with our sister company on iPSC treatment, biobanking, clinical\-trial site activities and joint patient programs. * Patient acquisition (CMO scope): US and Canadian demand generation across paid media (Google, Meta, YouTube), SEO and LLM visibility (we have an audit, a schema pack and a playbook in flight), content and founder/physician\-led media, reviews and social  its passed, documentation complete, incidents reported and closed. * A written operating playbook and staffing plan delivered on schedule. WHO YOU ARE * 8\+ years in healthcare operations, with at least 3 years running a clinic, surgical center, hospital service line, cash\-pay specialty practice, or medical\-tourism operation — as the person accountable for the numbers. * You have scaled a clinical operation before: more patients, more rooms, a second site, or a new service line — and you can describe exactly what broke and what you fixed. * You have personally driven patient or customer acquisition for a clinic or high\-ticket cash\-pay business — you have run paid campaigns, read the cohorts and owned a CAC number, not just managed an agency that did. * Hands\-on by temperament. You would rather fix the scheduling problem today than commission a study about it. * Comfortable with regulated environments: licensing, SOPs, quality systems, audits. Experience with COFEPRIS, cGMP, or international accreditation is a strong plus. * Financially literate: you can read a P\&L, build a staffing model, and hold a budget. * Excellent English; professional Spanish strongly preferred (our staff, hospital partner and regulators work in Spanish; our patients are English\-speaking). * Able and willing to be on site in Nuevo Vallarta at least two weeks every month. Candidates willing to live in Nuevo Vallarta full time will have an advantage in the process. * Bonus: experience in regenerative medicine, cell therapy, fertility, oncology, sports medicine, or another high\-touch, high\-ticket cash\-pay specialty; experience serving US or Canadian patients abroad. COMPENSATION This package is built for a builder, not a caretaker. If you need a market salary, this is not the right role; if you want real ownership in a company at the start of its growth curve, it is. * Base salary: $5,500 USD per month, paid by our US company. * Equity: a meaningful equity grant in RENUE Medical Centre, vesting over time and with additional tranches that vest on growth milestones — treated\-patient volume and contribution margin at the flagship. The better the growth you deliver, the larger your stake. * Performance bonus tied to monthly treated\-patient volume and contribution margin, to be agreed in your first 60 days. * Salary review at 12 months against the scaling model, with the intent to move base compensation up as volume and margin justify it. * Travel and accommodation for on\-site weeks covered if you are not local. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS * Complete an audit of current operations and acquisition: schedule, staffing, patient flow, Patient Advisor performance, cell supply, vendors, compliance status, ad accounts, SEO and partner referrals. * Deliver a written baseline of the key metrics — treated patients, CAC by channel, conversion at each stage, revenue per patient, contribution margin — and a 90\-day operating and acquisition plan tied to the path to 50 treated patients per month. * Take over weekly reporting to the Founder and the monthly update for the board. * Start the written operating playbook for the clinic. HOW TO APPLY Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note (in English) covering: * Two operations you have personally run — with the numbers: patient or case volume, headcount, budget, and what changed under you. * One acquisition program you personally ran, with actual CAC and volume numbers. * Your Spanish level, and whether you would relocate to Nuevo Vallarta full time or work the two\-weeks\-per\-month minimum. * Your view on the right mix of salary and equity for a role like this, and the growth milestones you would be comfortable tying equity to. We move quickly and will respond to qualified candidates within three business days. RENUE Medical Centre is an equal opportunity employer. renue.healthcare · Elevate Your Quality of Life Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $5,500\.00 per month Work Location: Hybrid remote in Scottsdale, AZ 85257

jobs.description: Overview: Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career. At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose\-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day. Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role. Responsibilities: Now Hiring for an Manufacturing Process Engineer (Industrial Engineer) at our Murrysville, PA manufacturing plant. In this role you will be counted on to perform the following: **Process Design*** Design and optimize manufacturing processes, including but not limited to process sequence flow, line balancing, capacity planning, and production layouts, ensuring efficient, safe, and scalable operations. * Lead and participate in process risk assessments, including PFMEA and ergonomics evaluations, to proactively address and mitigate safety, quality, and operational risks. * Collaborate with engineering, production, and finance teams to justify CAPEX investments and select appropriate machinery for the manufacturing process. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (operations, facilities, finance) to scope, justify, and implement capital projects. Participate in long term capital investment planning to align with business growth, operations strategy and capacity planning. * Utilize simulation tools to validate process flows, resource requirements, and production efficiency. * Support the overall plant layout design strategy to ensure efficient material flow, scalability and production. **Process Implementation*** Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and visual work aids to standardize processes and improve consistency. * Prepare work cells and production areas for new product introductions or process changes, ensuring readiness and minimal disruption to production. * Provide Train\- the \-trainer sessions to front line leaders on new processes, tools, and workflows. * Partner with safety teams to ensures processes meets safety standards. * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of capital equipment projects, from initial concept and design through procurement, installation, and commissioning. Including but not limited to TPM, business continuity for equipment, spare parts, and any service agreements or training needed to support the equipment. **Process Validation*** Conduct process validation studies including time studies, measurement system analysis and capability assessments. * Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) such as OEE, FPY, and CPK to confirm process capability and identify areas for improvement. * Partner with quality teams to ensure processes meet internal standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations **Design for Manufacturability*** Owning manufacturing requirements for product design. Collaborate with R\&D teams early in the development cycle to integrate DFM principles, ensuring products are cost\-effective, scalable, and manufacturable. * Provide feedback on design feasibility, tooling requirements, and process constraints to minimize downstream production issues. * Partner with Advanced Manufacturing and OT to review design for automation opportunities. **Continuous Improvement/Lean Manufacturing*** Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives using Lean tools such as value stream mapping (VSM), kaizen, and standard work development. * Collect and evaluate data to identify opportunities for process improvement. Use problem\-solving methodologies and analysis (DoE, SPC, 5 Whys, A3, Fishbone) to identify the root cause implement the corrective actions/improvements. * Identify and eliminate waste in processes while embedding sustainability and energy efficiency principles. * Promote a culture of continuous improvement across the production organization through training, coaching, and mentoring. * Leverage shop\-floor data from MES, ERP, and other digital tools to drive analytics\-based decision\-making and process optimization. Support and maintain shop floor digital tools. **Direct Production Support*** Provide troubleshooting support for complex engineering problems with equipment and processes. For ongoing daily troubleshooting provide training to relevant teams as and when needed * Ensure compliance with internal and external standards through regular process audits and monitoring. * Maintain robust documentation and governance practices across operational processes. **Master Data Management*** Own and maintain master data in ERP systems to ensure all data accurately reflects actual manufacturing processes. Data could include bills of materials (BOMs) for KMATs, quantity of consumables, routings and product cost estimates. * Validate and update BOMs and routings for new and existing products, coordinating with the R\&D team to prevent discrepancies that could impact cost, lead time, or quality. * Ensure ERP data integrity to support accurate production planning, inventory management, and financial reporting. * Drive continuous improvement of master data standards through best practice sharing Qualifications: **Special Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:*** Strong problem\-solving mindset with experience in Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement. * Knowledge of manufacturing technologies, including machines and process equipment. * Cross\-functional collaboration and effective communication skills, with the ability to lead change. * Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage multiple priorities. * Continuous learning orientation and adaptability in a dynamic manufacturing environment. **Education and Experience Required:*** Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field from an ABET accredited program. This position will be considered at two different career levels based upon experience and education:* Level one (Staff I): 0 years of relevant industry experience * Level two (Staff II): 2 years of relevant industry experience * Level three (Staff III): 3\+ years of relevant industry experience **Experience Preferred*** Experience with simulation software and data analysis tools * Exposure to manufacturing analytics and digital tools for process optimization. * Familiarity with automation and robotics * Experience in advanced manufacturing concepts, process innovation, and industry best practices. * Knowledge in ERP (e.g., SAP) and MES (e.g., Kanoa) systems for data accuracy and production support. * Previous intern or co\-op experience, preferably in a manufacturing setting * Knowledge of the MSA Operating System and Lean Manufacturing Techniques (Value Stream Mapping, One Piece Flow, Setup Reduction, Lean Management, Visual Controls, Six Sigma, etc.). \#LI\-GM1

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Smart people. Smart ideas. Smart choice.** -------------------------------------------- MTS is a leading global supplier of test and simulation systems. Formula 1 teams, leading automotive and aerospace companies, and the world's top researchers in materials and seismic engineering all rely on our systems to determine product reliability and ensure compliance with quality standards. Check out some of our amazing technology here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=vXOsvWpTHH4 As an ITW company, MTS is part of a Fortune 300 global manufacturing leader with 49,000 employees across 56 countries, offering career development opportunities not just within MTS but across the ITW enterprise. We're looking for an **Embedded Software Engineer** who is a self\-directed individual to implement motor controls in customized embedded code for highly efficient, real\-time, on\-board systems. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will work as a key team member alongside other subject matter experts on projects from concept through design to implementation. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Develop software requirements, design, implementation, verification, and validation for embedded control of custom electric motors and variable frequency drives * Simulate physical plant, control, and feedback signal to support system design optimization and predict control performance * Perform unit software testing and bread\-board bench testing to minimize debugging time needed on full system * Develop test plans and unit test set\-ups to validate and verify software and system performance * Integrate software, variable frequency drive, and custom motor prototypes in full\-system factory test lab, remotely, and on\-site customer locations * Plan, implement, and report status of software features to internal and external customers * Other accountabilities/duties as assigned by the manager **What You Bring:** ------------------- * B.S. in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical or equivalent from an ABET accredited institution (advanced degree preferred) * Minimum 5 years engineering experience * Use of Matlab/Simulink, especially for integrated controls design and auto\-compilation to hardware * Experience working with modern control chipsets e.g., (Texas Instruments, Xilinx) * Demonstrated ability to support customers, and set/meet expectations at all technical and/or programmatic levels * Implementation of advanced motor control technologies, including field weakening, harmonic modulation, over\- and/or window\-based sampling, direct\-torque, sensorless algorithm, etc.) * Experience with fast\-paced projects (e.g,. Motorsport) to make and communicate good engineering decisions under pressured deadlines **Best in Class Benefits:** --------------------------- * Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance: http://myitwhr.com/ * HSA/FSA with a company match * Income protection benefits * Industry leading 401(k) plan * Paid time off * Parental leave * Matching gift and volunteer program **Get Involved and Give Back:** MTS supports Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together to share experiences and ideas, and we're committed to a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute their talents. Through the ITW Hearts Giving Hope Program, employees also have the chance to give back and support families in our communities. **Compensation Information:** $106,000 \- $150,000 Annual Salary, commensurate with experience and qualifications. *ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.* *As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*
